Title: BI & Data Analytics Expert – GCP
Description:
BI & Data Analytics Expert – GCP 

Entrerai a far parte dei team BI e Data Analytics, dove contribuirai a trasformare i dati in informazioni utili per le decisioni di business. Lavorerai lungo tutta la filiera analitica: dalla raccolta dei requisiti e dall’analisi delle fonti, alla modellazione e preparazione dei dati, fino alla realizzazione di dashboard, report e soluzioni di analytics. 

Avrai un ruolo di riferimento nella progettazione e nell’evoluzione di piattaforme dati su Google Cloud, aiutando i clienti a definire architetture adatte alle loro esigenze e guidando le attività di progetto. Collaborerai con figure di Data Engineering, Data Science, architettura e governance per rendere i dati affidabili, accessibili e pronti per l’analisi e la visualizzazione. 

Quando il caso d’uso lo richiede, contribuirai anche a integrare funzionalità di AI nelle soluzioni analitiche: ad esempio, per generare insight, interpretare i dati o supportare gli utenti nell’interazione con le informazioni. L’obiettivo è portare queste soluzioni dalla sperimentazione a un utilizzo concreto, tenendo conto di qualità, sicurezza, scalabilità e governabilità. 

In base alla tua esperienza, potrai coordinare le attività di progetto, affiancare profili junior e presentare proposte e risultati a clienti, colleghi e partner tecnologici. 

Requisiti indispensabili 




3–6 anni di esperienza in ambito Business Intelligence, Data Analytics o Data Platform. 




Laurea magistrale in discipline STEM o esperienza equivalente. 




Solida conoscenza di SQL e delle attività di estrazione, pulizia, trasformazione, modellazione e analisi dei dati. 




Esperienza con BigQuery e con la progettazione o gestione di data warehouse e pipeline dati su Google Cloud. 




Esperienza con almeno uno strumento di BI e data visualization, Looker, Tableau, Power BI o Qlik Sense. 




Conoscenza dei principi di modellazione dimensionale, KPI, qualità del dato e data governance. 




Capacità di raccogliere requisiti di business e tradurli in soluzioni analitiche chiare e utilizzabili. 




Buona conoscenza di Python per analisi, automazione o trattamento dei dati. 




Italiano e inglese fluenti. 




Competenze cloud e di piattaforma 




Conoscenza dei principali servizi GCP per dati e analytics, come BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Composer e Vertex AI. 




Comprensione delle architetture data lake e data warehouse e dei processi batch e, preferibilmente, real time. 




Capacità di valutare le scelte architetturali in base a requisiti di performance, costi, sicurezza e scalabilità. 





Esperienza nel documentare soluzioni e nel favorire il riuso, la manutenibilità e l’affidabilità delle componenti sviluppate. 




La certificazione Google Professional Data Engineer o equivalente è considerata un plus. 




AI e Machine Learning – competenze preferenziali 




Familiarità con i concetti fondamentali di Machine Learning e con il ciclo di vita dei modelli. 




Esperienza o interesse concreto nell’integrazione di servizi e modelli AI in soluzioni dati, BI o analytics, ad esempio tramite Vertex AI, Gemini o API di modelli generativi. 




Conoscenza dei principi di MLOps, monitoraggio, sicurezza e valutazione delle soluzioni AI. 




Capacità di individuare casi d’uso AI pertinenti e di valutarne la fattibilità e il valore per il business. 




Soft skill 




Approccio consulenziale, orientamento al cliente e capacità di facilitare il dialogo tra interlocutori tecnici e di business. 




Capacità di guidare attività e coordinare il lavoro di team multidisciplinari. 




Comunicazione chiara dei risultati e capacità di trasformare analisi complesse in raccomandazioni comprensibili. 




Autonomia, precisione e attenzione alla qualità, con capacità di rispettare priorità e scadenze. 




Attitudine alla collaborazione e alla condivisione delle competenze. 




Perchè Bip? 

Crescita e Formazione 
Più di 300 corsi su tecnologie e business emergenti, programmi di sviluppo personalizzati e iniziative di training e people care per supportare la tua crescita professionale e personale. 

Flessibilità e Work-Life Integration 
Lavoro agile con possibilità di programmare le giornate da remoto e in ufficio con il proprio responsabile e in base alle esigenze di progetto, Banca Ore Solidale per usufruire o mettere a disposizione ore di permesso a colleghi e colleghe che vivono momenti di difficoltà e una cultura che favorisce l’equilibrio tra vita e lavoro. 

Salute & Benefits  
Assicurazione sanitaria, check-up agevolati, piattaforme per il benessere psicofisico e un piano welfare integrativo. Ticket restaurant e altri benefit dedicati. 

Famiglia e Genitorialità 
Supporto concreto a neogenitori: integrazione al 100% per i primi 3 mesi del congedo parentale o bonus una tantum, giorni extra per i papà e iniziative di supporto durante il congedo e al rientro in azienda. 

Inclusione e Valori 
Promuoviamo l’unicità e garantiamo pari opportunità a tutte le persone. Lavoriamo per un ambiente etico, equo e accogliente, anche attraverso politiche attive per le categorie protette (L. 68/99). 

  

Next Steps 

Una volta ricevuto il tuo cv ci prenderemo del tempo per valutarlo attentamente. 

Se c’è un match con questa o con altre posizioni aperte all’interno del Gruppo, ti contatteremo per iniziare la nostra conoscenza reciproca. 

L’iter di selezione comprende generalmente un colloquio con HR, un colloquio tecnico con un line manager ed un eventuale colloquio con un Partner. 

L’ordine e il numero delle interviste potrebbero variare a seconda delle esigenze di recruiting. 

  

In alternativa, saremo felici di conservare il tuo CV nel nostro database per poterlo rivalutare per altre opportunità future. 

Se dovessi identificare ulteriori posizioni di tuo interesse ed in linea con il tuo profilo, aspettiamo la tua candidatura per poterla valutare nuovamente. 

Cosa offriamo / What we offer 

La retribuzione prevista per questa posizione è compresa tra € 34.000 e € 48.000 lordi annui, in funzione dell'esperienza, delle competenze e del livello di seniority del candidato. 

 L'inquadramento sarà definito durante il processo di selezione sulla base del profilo individuato e nel rispetto della normativa e del CCNL Metalmeccanici Industria 

La retribuzione indicata si riferisce alla sola RAL (Retribuzione Annua Lorda). 

Il pacchetto complessivo può includere ulteriori componenti variabili, correlate al raggiungimento di specifici obiettivi individuali e/o aziendali, welfare e benefit aziendali. La proposta economica finale sarà definita in base alle caratteristiche del profilo selezionato e alla coerenza con i requisiti della posizione

Supporto concreto a neogenitori: integrazione al 100% per i primi 3 mesi del congedo parentale o bonus una tantum, giorni extra per i papà e iniziative di supporto durante il congedo e al rientro in azienda. 

Inclusione e Valori 
Promuoviamo l’unicità e garantiamo pari opportunità a tutte le persone. Lavoriamo per un ambiente etico, equo e accogliente, anche attraverso politiche attive per le categorie protette (L. 68/99). 

  

Next Steps 

Una volta ricevuto il tuo cv ci prenderemo del tempo per valutarlo attentamente. 

Se c’è un match con questa o con altre posizioni aperte all’interno del Gruppo, ti contatteremo per iniziare la nostra conoscenza reciproca. 

L’iter di selezione comprende generalmente un colloquio con HR, un colloquio tecnico con un line manager ed un eventuale colloquio con un Partner. 

L’ordine e il numero delle interviste potrebbero variare a seconda delle esigenze di recruiting. 

  

In alternativa, saremo felici di conservare il tuo CV nel nostro database per poterlo rivalutare per altre opportunità future. 

Se dovessi identificare ulteriori posizioni di tuo interesse ed in linea con il tuo profilo, aspettiamo la tua candidatura per poterla valutare nuovamente. 

Cosa offriamo / What we offer 

La retribuzione prevista per questa posizione è compresa tra € 34.000 e € 48.000 lordi annui, in funzione dell'esperienza, delle competenze e del livello di seniority del candidato. 

 L'inquadramento sarà definito durante il processo di selezione sulla base del profilo individuato e nel rispetto della normativa e del CCNL Metalmeccanici Industria

Title: DATA & CUSTOMER INTELLIGENCE MANAGER
Description:
Re-Forme S.r.L. nasce nel 2009 con l’apertura del centro estetico “Veralab Institute” che ha ispirato, nel 2015, la nascita di Veralab, il brand skincare fondato da Cristina Fogazzi, diventato uno dei principali player del settore cosmetico con un fatturato di oltre 70 milioni di euro.

La mission del brand è offrire prodotti skincare e trattamenti corpo di sicura efficacia grazie ad una strenua ricerca della qualità unita all’expertise del know-how italiano.

In pochi anni, Veralab è divenuta l’enfant prodige del beauty italiano sviluppando un modello di business “click and mortar” che integra perfettamente online e offline in una sinergia omni-channel che affianca all’e-commerce proprietario oltre 870 touch point tra Flagship Store (Milano, Roma, Torino, Padova, Bologna, Arese, Palermo, Bari, Oriocenter e Serravalle), Luxury Department Store e Profumerie e Farmacie selezionate.

Nel giugno 2023 nasce Overskin, il brand make-up con attivi skincare che mutua l’esperienza di Veralab garantendo elevata qualità e performance delle formule, unita alla facilità di utilizzo.

Posizione:

Per il nostro team e-commerce siamo alla ricerca di un/una Data & Customer Intelligence Manager da inserire con l’obiettivo di valorizzare il patrimonio informativo aziendale e trasformare dati e insight in decisioni di business concrete.

La risorsa sarà responsabile dello sviluppo delle capability di Customer Intelligence, Analytics e Business Intelligence , supportando la crescita del canale digitale e l’evoluzione della customer experience attraverso un approccio data-driven.

Cerchiamo una figura con solide competenze analitiche e una forte visione orientata al business, capace di collaborare efficacemente con i team CRM, Loyalty, Digital Product ed Ecommerce per trasformare insight e comportamenti in azioni misurabili e ad alto impatto.

Principali responsabilità:


Definire e guidare le strategie di Customer Intelligence, sviluppando modelli di analisi avanzata per comprendere il comportamento cliente e individuare opportunità di crescita lungo il customer lifecycle;
Governare i modelli di segmentazione e targeting, progettando audience e cluster a supporto delle iniziative CRM, Loyalty, Trading, Product e Customer Experience;
Supportare le attività CRM e Loyalty attraverso insight, analisi e modelli di attivazione, garantendo qualità ed efficacia delle campagne e delle iniziative di engagement;
Fornire supporto alle decisioni di business attraverso KPI, dashboard, analisi e reporting a beneficio delle diverse funzioni digitali;
Promuovere il miglioramento continuo delle performance attraverso analisi, sperimentazioni e attività di misurazione orientate all’ottimizzazione dei risultati;
Coordinare le attività del team analytics, contribuendo allo sviluppo delle competenze interne e alla diffusione di una cultura decisionale basata sui dati.


Requisiti:


Laurea in Statistica, Economia, Ingegneria Gestionale, Matematica, Data Science o discipline affini;
Almeno 5-6 anni di esperienza in ruoli di Customer Analytics, CRM Analytics o Business Intelligence;
Ottima conoscenza di SQL e delle principali metodologie di analisi dati;
Esperienza nella progettazione di modelli di segmentazione cliente e customer analytics avanzate;
Esperienza con strumenti di Business Intelligence, preferibilmente Power BI;
Conoscenza dei principali KPI digitali, CRM ed eCommerce.
Familiarità con piattaforme CRM; la conoscenza di BigQuery, dbt e ambienti cloud costituisce un plus;
Ottime capacità analitiche, comunicative e di collaborazione con stakeholder business e team cross-funzionali.


Altre informazioni:

Settore Azienda

E-COMMERCE & DIGITAL

Informazioni sull'offerta di lavoro


Rapporto di lavoro: contratto a tempo indeterminato full-time
Inquadramento: 1° livello del CCNL Commercio, Distribuzione e Servizi
Orario di lavoro: dal lunedì al venerdì
Retribuzione annua lorda (RAL): indicativamente compresa tra € 60.000 e € 65.000, sulla base di elementi quali esperienza maturata, competenze possedute, percorso formativo e coerenza con il ruolo e il contesto di riferimento
Benefit: ticket restaurant, assistenza sanitaria integrativa e piano di welfare aziendale

Necessaria esperienza pregressa di almeno 5-6 anni in ruoli di Customer Analytics, CRM Analytics o Business Intelligence

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst - Management Consultant - Categorie protette (68/99)
Description:
In SDG hai l’opportunità di diventare un esperto di Financial Analytics e di entrare a far parte di una delle società più all'avanguardia d’Europa in questo ambito. Potrai partecipare a diversi progetti nazionali e internazionali lavorando in team giovani e dinamici. Vengono effettuate valutazioni periodiche di performance e acquisizione di skills che ti permetteranno di fare velocemente carriera nella nostra realtà. Avrai inoltre modo di costruire il tuo career path personalizzato scegliendo tra diversi percorsi. Partendo da un livello base, attraverso training, coaching, mentoring, e un approccio never-stop-learning diventerai un esperto nella progettazione e sviluppo di practices tramite le quali far adottare ai nostri clienti un’ottica data driven.

Affrontiamo problematiche complesse nell’ambito di progetti che mirano all'efficientamento economico-finanziario e alle strategie d'impresa attingendo a competenze trasversali. Il nostro intervento si concentra sui processi di financial planning & controlling con l’obiettivo di sviluppare, in sinergia con tutti gli stakeholder, delle soluzioni per ottimizzare l'operatività quotidiana attraverso l’adozione di piattaforme tecnologiche.

Le industries e i settori coinvolti spaziano dal Banking & Finance, CPG & FMCG, all’Industrial Manufacturing e al Fashion & Retail.




Your Challenges:

Diventare un esperto di corporate performance management: area rivolta alla massimizzazione dell’efficienza e della qualità dei processi di Financial Analytics
Creare modelli di monitoraggio, pianificazione e previsione finanziaria (FP&A) e modelli consolidati per gruppi e aziende
Introdurre strutture comuni di allocazione dei costi e reportistica in conformità con i GAAP finanziari locali




Your activities:

Incontri con il cliente per la raccolta e razionalizzazione dei requisiti di dettaglio
Partecipazione ad attività di ri-modellazione dei processi di pianificazione
Supporto nella fase di test e training al cliente




Requirements:

Laurea magistrale in Discipline Economiche (o altre discipline tecnico-scientifiche)
Forte attitudine alla tecnologia: SQL, VBA, R, Board sono alcune delle tecnologie che vengono utilizzate, non preoccuparti se la tua conoscenza è a un livello base abbiamo un Learning Center e un percorso di training strutturato che ti renderanno velocemente un Data Cruncher
Spiccato interesse per tematiche legate all'efficientamento economico-finanziario e alle strategie d'impresa
Conoscenza degli applicativi del pacchetto Office, in particolare viene richiesta una dimestichezza nelle funzioni base di excel
Team Player: un buon giocatore di squadra è una persona altruista, dinamica, entusiasta, resiliente e positiva. Sono elementi alla base dei Valori SDG e lavoriamo per far crescere una cultura dei valori a tutti i livelli.
Capacità di trasformare dati aziendali in informazioni che possono essere presentate agli stakeholder interni o esterni per suggerire delle decisioni data-driven
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese parlata e scritta, meglio se avvalorata da un’esperienza all’estero
Disponibilità a trasferte nazionali ed internazionali




Rock your future with SDG:

Academy interne e centri di eccellenza qualificati con possibilità di ottenere certificazioni per i tools più utilizzati nel campo dei big data & analytics: Qlik, PowerBI, Board, Tableau, Microstrategy, SAP Analytics, AWS Redshift, Oracle DB, SQL Server, Google Bigquery, Snowflake etc.;
Never stop learning: formazione continua per tutto l’arco della carriera con 160 ore di training iniziale e successiva attività di coaching e mentoring.
Valutazioni semestrali del potenziale e della performance.
Ambiente internazionale e giovane: età media inferiore a 30 anni e possibilità di trasferte all’estero.
Smart working: possibilità di organizzare e gestire in maniera autonoma la presenza in ufficio in accordo con le esigenze progettuali
SDG Community: entrare in SDG non significa soltanto lavorare in SDG ma diventare parte di una comunità di persone, infatti troverai tante iniziative sia per il benessere fisico che quello mentale, organizzate direttamente dai tuoi colleghi




What we offer:

Tipologia di contratto: contratto di apprendistato professionalizzante o contratto a tempo indeterminato. CCNL Commercio.
Retribuzione: RAL indicativa nel range: 26.000€ - 28.000€. Il posizionamento all'interno del range sarà definito in base alle competenze tecniche, all'esperienza specifica nel ruolo e agli esiti del processo di selezione, secondo criteri oggettivi e predefiniti. In presenza di profili con caratteristiche eccezionali rispetto al range indicato, una revisione potrà essere valutata previa approvazione interna.
Modalità di lavoro: modalità ibrida.
Altri benefits: assicurazione sanitaria integrativa, ticket restaurant e welfare aziendale.







SDG Group:

Lavorare in SDG significa entrare a far parte di una delle società di management consulting in più rapida crescita nell’ambito dei Business Analytics, Corporate performance Management e Advanced Business Solutions. Con più di 2000 professionisti in tutto il mondo è stata riconosciuta da Gartner tra le 37 società più all’avanguardia nel settore dei Data & Analytics, l’unica italiana e seconda in Europa. SDG opera in Italia con 3 uffici (Milano, Firenze, Verona) e dislocamenti in Spagna, Portogallo, Francia, UK, USA e Middle East. Mettiamo la nostra esperienza nel settore degli Analytics a disposizione delle aziende per potenziare le loro strategie di business, facendole diventare organizzazioni data-driven di successo

Title: Data Engineer/Analyst - Graduate Development Program
Description:
About ION

We are a Software Product Company with a global footprint in the FinTech sector. With more than 10,000 professionals across 40+ offices worldwide, we provide solutions combining trading and workflow automation, market data, and advanced business intelligence.

Our Graduate Development Program is a three-year journey designed for recent graduates who look beyond the obvious, challenge existing processes, and are driven to automate and reinvent the way things work.

The program is structured into 4 progressive phases, each with distinct learning objectives. Tasks evolve according to your abilities and interests, ensuring the experience is as individual as you are.

From day one, you join ION on a full‑time permanent contract, carry real accountability on live projects, and be paired with senior professionals who guide your development throughout the entire journey.

What You'll Do

Across phases, you will become the owner of full data transformation and reporting pipelines, working at the intersection of business processes and technology. Your work will include:


Interacting with business and process owners to understand data sources, reconstruct their semantics, and assess their value
Performing exploratory data analysis, reverse engineering, and building multidimensional BI models as a single source of truth
Automating data extraction, cleaning, transformation, enrichment, and standardization to feed central Data Hubs
Implementing automated reporting across multiple channels — Power BI dashboards, programmatic PowerPoint generation, and custom web UIs
Managing and maintaining operational data pipelines end-to-end


What We're Looking For


Master's degree in a STEM discipline — obtained within the last year or currently in progress, with a strong academic record
Solid command of Python and SQL for data analysis; familiarity with statistical concepts and time series analysis is a plus
Strong communicator, collaborative by nature, and fluent in both English (B2+) and Italian
Based in Italy or willing to relocate; non-EU candidates must hold a valid EU work permit


Nice to have: Power BI, Databricks or Apache Spark, DBMS / NoSQL, Scala, Postegres / Esatic.

Gross Salary Range

34.000 - 38.000 EUR

Pursuant to Italian Law (L.68/99), candidates registered on the disability list will be given priority. Only candidates meeting the selection criteria will be contacted. Please apply only if you currently hold full legal right to work in Italy.

Title: SDA Junior Analyst Insight
Description:
Job Description



ABOUT THIS JOB



Data is what makes the world go round. Brands, companies and even individuals like yourself rely strongly on data and this need for data is not just for data, but for fast, reliable and human intelligence fostered insights.



As Junior Analyst Insight in Small Domestic Appliances team, you will act as a partner to our clients, ensuring they achieve maximum value from our solutions maintaining high client satisfaction.

Title: Business Analyst
Description:
We are looking for a Business Analyst to support performance planning, forecasting, and financial analysis across our retail and e-commerce business. Reporting to the Planning & Performance Manager, you will turn data into the insight that guides commercial and management decisions, with a strong focus on business performance and profitability.




This is a hands-on, analytical role for someone who is comfortable moving between sales performance, forecasting, and the numbers behind the P&L, across both physical retail and digital channels.




What you'll do:

Business analysis and performance

Analyze business performance on a weekly, monthly, and seasonal basis, turning data into clear insight and actionable recommendations for management and merchandising teams.
Build and maintain forecasting and sales projection models across markets, channels, and store clusters (flagship, department store, outlet), supporting demand planning and OTB definition.
Analyze sell-through, stock exposure, and product rotation to identify risks and opportunities, and recommend corrective actions to improve performance and stock efficiency.

Financial performance and profitability

Support P&L analysis and reporting, monitoring operating costs and margins to ensure alignment with financial targets.
Track profitability by channel, category, and initiative, providing the analysis needed to support pricing and investment decisions.
Contribute to budgeting and forecasting cycles with structured analysis and performance projections.

Reporting and business intelligence

Develop and maintain an advanced reporting and KPI framework, fostering a data-driven culture across the team.
Prepare periodic performance reviews and reporting packages that bring the numbers to the decision-making table, not just to the file.




What we're looking for:

2 to 4 years of experience in business analysis, planning, FP&A, or a similar analytical role, ideally in retail, fashion, or e-commerce.
Academic background in Economics, Business, Finance, Engineering, or a related field.
Strong analytical mindset, comfortable working across both commercial performance and financial data (sales, margin, P&L, cost).
Advanced Excel is essential. Power BI (or a comparable BI tool) is a strong plus, as our reporting runs on it.
Ability to translate analysis into clear, decision-ready recommendations for non-analytical stakeholders.
Precise, organized, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
Fluent English; Italian is a plus given the Milan base.

Nice to have:

Experience with forecasting or demand planning models.
Exposure to P&L and profitability analysis.
Familiarity with a multi-channel or multi-format retail network.




What we offer:

Compensation package up to €35,000 gross annual salary, plus meal vouchers.
Learning & Development Programs: continuous learning experiences with TLG University and other projects.
Be part of a young (31 on average) and international (+30 nationalities) group and work in a dynamic and fast-moving environment.

Title: Client Data Manager
Description:
Il Client Data Manager è una figura pienamente autonoma all'interno del team Design & Measurement. E' responsabile della trasformazione dei dati media, brand e di business in insight, raccomandazioni e misurazioni a supporto delle decisioni strategiche dei clienti e dei team interni all’agenzia. Si avvale della collaborazione dei data Assistant e data Analyst, con una crescente responsabilità verso stakeholder, governance dei dati e qualità della misurazione.




Scopo del ruolo

Il Client Data Manager è il referente per i clienti assegnati in merito alla raccolta, analisi, interpretazione e valorizzazione dei dati media, di brand e di business, con l'obiettivo di misurare l'efficacia delle attività di comunicazione e supportare le decisioni strategiche.

La figura collabora inoltre trasversalmente con tutte le funzioni di agenzia, garantendo la produzione di analisi avanzate, framework di misurazione e reporting evoluti per ottimizzare gli investimenti media e le performance di business.

Contribuisce inoltre in modo attivo alle fasi di gara e alle attività di New Business.




Principali responsabilità

Data Analysis & Measurement

Analizzare le performance delle pianificazioni media con un approccio full funnel (media, brand, business)
Interpretare dati provenienti da diverse fonti (piattaforme media, dati proprietari e di mercato) per fornire analisi e insight avanzati
Valutare la relazione tra risultati media e obiettivi di brand e di business, individuando driver di performance e aree di ottimizzazione
Definire framework di misurazione e metodologie di tracking coerenti con gli obiettivi del cliente
Sviluppare e implementare modelli analitici avanzati (es. MMM, Sales Uplift, Attribution) per quantificare l'impatto reale delle leve media sui risultati di business del cliente




Reporting & Data Visualization

Supervisionare dashboard e sistemi di reporting automatizzato
Garantire accuratezza, coerenza e qualità dei dati utilizzati nelle analisi
Tradurre dati complessi in insight chiari e raccomandazioni operative per clienti e stakeholder interni
Presentare risultati e learning emersi dalle campagne ai team di pianificazione e consulenza




Business & Media Insights

Condurre analisi di benchmark di mercato, competitività e media landscape
Approfondire trend di investimento, comportamenti di consumo media e dinamiche competitive
Contribuire ai progetti di New Business e alle gare d'agenzia, disegnando il framework di misurazione per i prospect e fornendo insight strategici a supporto delle raccomandazioni media
Supportare la costruzione di strategie data-driven attraverso insight quantitativi e qualitativi
Identificare opportunità di ottimizzazione media, audience e investimenti




Project Management

Coordinare le attività analitiche sui clienti assegnati
Gestire la relazione con i referenti dati e marketing lato cliente, agendo come punto di riferimento consulenziale per le tematiche di misurazione
Definire priorità, timeline e deliverable relativi alle attività di reporting e measurement
Fornire guida metodologica a figure più junior (Assistant e Analyst)
Collaborare con partner tecnologici e fornitori dati per garantire la disponibilità e la qualità delle informazioni




Innovation & Automation

Promuovere l'automazione dei processi di analisi e reporting
Contribuire all'evoluzione degli strumenti di Business Intelligence e data visualization
Supportare l'adozione di nuove soluzioni di misurazione e tecnologie data-driven
Individuare nuove modalità di integrazione tra media, customer e business data
Sperimentare e promuovere l'integrazione di strumenti e metodologie AI-driven per l'analisi avanzata




Competenze richieste

Competenze tecniche

Solida esperienza nell'analisi dati marketing e media
Ottima conoscenza di Excel e strumenti di analisi dati
Conoscenza di piattaforme di reporting e visualizzazione dati (Power BI o equivalenti)
Conoscenza dei modelli econometrici e di attribuzione (MMM, Attribution framework) e strumenti per la modellazione dati (es. Python, R o tool statistici equivalenti)
Capacità di gestione di dataset complessi e di verifica della qualità del dato
Conoscenza delle principali metriche digital, offline e omnicanale




Competenze analitiche

Forte orientamento all'analisi quantitativa
Capacità di individuare insight rilevanti e tradurli in raccomandazioni concrete, in coerenza con progetti complessi
Approccio strutturato al problem solving
Elevata attenzione ai dettagli e all'accuratezza del dato




Competenze relazionali

Capacità di gestione degli stakeholder
Efficacia nella presentazione di dati e risultati
Attitudine alla collaborazione in contesti multidisciplinari
Capacità di guidare e supportare risorse junior




Requisiti

Laurea in Economia, Statistica, Marketing, Ingegneria Gestionale, Data Science o discipline affini
Esperienza di 4-6 anni in agenzie media, consulenza, marketing analytics, business intelligence o contesti digital
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese
Interesse per innovazione, tecnologia e utilizzo strategico dei dati




Sede di lavoro: Milano

Orario di lavoro: Full-time




Tipologia di contratto: Tempo indeterminato

Fascia retributiva (retribuzione annua lorda): € 40.000-45.000

Il pacchetto retributivo proposto è determinato in base a criteri oggettivi e trasparenti, e tiene conto dei requisiti richiesti, complessità del ruolo, riferimenti di mercato ed equilibrio interno.

Title: Analista aziendale
Description:
Cerchiamo una persona da inserire nel team della Divisione Ristorazione e Vending, con il ruolo di Business Analyst Divisione Ristorazione e Vending. La risorsa effettua il monitoraggio delle performance economiche e operative delle commesse, contribuendo al raggiungimento degli obiettivi aziendali attraverso l'analisi dei dati, il presidio dei KPI, il coordinamento delle attività operative e l'individuazione di opportunità di miglioramento continuo.




Responsabilità principali

Monitorare costantemente le performance economiche e operative delle commesse della Divisione.
Analizzare scostamenti rispetto a budget, forecast e trend, identificandone le cause e proponendo azioni correttive.
Elaborare report periodici e presentazioni direzionali a supporto delle decisioni strategiche.
Analizzare e monitorare i KPI di business, evidenziando opportunità di miglioramento delle performance.
Fornire supporto alla predisposizione di offerte commerciali attraverso analisi economiche e dati di supporto.
Individuare opportunità di contenimento dei costi delle commesse e dei servizi collegati.
Costituire il punto di raccordo tra le strutture operative e le funzioni di controllo e pianificazione.




Chi cerchiamo

La persona che cerchiamo è curiosa, proattiva e dotata di una forte capacità di leggere e interpretare i dati per trasformarli in informazioni utili alle decisioni aziendali. Possiede spiccate capacità organizzative, attenzione al dettaglio e una naturale predisposizione alla collaborazione con interlocutori diversi.




Formazione

Laurea in Economia, Ingegneria Gestionale, Statistica, discipline Giuridiche o affini.

Esperienza

Esperienza di almeno 2-5 anni in ruoli di Business Analysis, Controllo di Gestione, Performance Management o Coordinamento Operativo.
Gradita provenienza dal settore ristorazione collettiva, dei servizi alle imprese e/o della GDO.

Competenze Tecniche

Ottima conoscenza di Excel e del pacchetto Microsoft Office.
Capacità di analisi dati e interpretazione di KPI economici e operativi.
Conoscenza dei processi di budgeting, forecasting e controllo delle performance.
Familiarità con sistemi ERP, strumenti di reportistica e Business Intelligence.
Capacità di elaborare presentazioni e report direzionali

Competenze Trasversali

Forte orientamento al risultato e al miglioramento continuo.
Capacità analitiche e problem solving.
Precisione e attenzione al dettaglio.
Capacità organizzative e di coordinamento.
Ottime doti relazionali e comunicative.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
WHAT IS CREAM ALL ABOUT?

We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency…

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

The Cream recipe

• 1/3 Personal development • 1/3 Collective intelligence • 1/3 Intrapreneurship • Bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues




YOUR FUTURE PROJECTS :

As Benjamin Data Analyst at Cream, you work close to business teams and help them turn data into concrete insights that support decision-making.




Your tasks will be :

• Understand business needs and translate them into analytical questions

• Collect, clean and analyse large datasets

• Identify trends, patterns and performance drivers

• Build dashboards, reports and analytical outputs

• Support business users in data interpretation

• Contribute to the selection and use of analytics tools

• Work closely with business, IT and data teams




WHAT DO WE EXPECT FROM OUR CONSULTANT ?

• At least 2 years of experience in data analysis AND Master’s degree (or equivalent in experience)

• Experience with SQL and BI tools (Power BI, Qlik, Tableau, …)

• Knowledge of Python or SAS

• Fluent in French and English, a good level of Dutch is an asset

• Ability to explain data insights in a clear and business-oriented way

• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset




WHY SHOULD YOU TASTE THE LIME FLAVOR ?

A strong learning environment: tribes, training budget
Career follow-up with dedicated Business Managers and an associate plan
Attractive benefits package (mobility plan, meal vouchers, insurances,...)
Hybrid working model: client working, home working & Cream working
Strong CSR commitments, with recognized labels in environmental responsibility and diversity & inclusion.
A consulting company of around 200 Creamers, located in the center of Brussels




Our recruitment process is clear and structured, with three steps and feedback throughout.

Cream Consulting is committed to equal opportunities. If you need any specific accommodation to fully participate in the recruitment process or the interview, please let us know.

Think this role is a match? Apply and let’s talk, or explore our other opportunities at Cream.

Title: Job | Senior Data Analyst | Brussel
Description:
Omschrijving

Je analyseert gegevens en stelt rapporten samen om zo bij te dragen aan het verbeteren en opvolgen van de financiële en commerciële prestaties binnen levensverzekeringen.

De job in een notendop

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het uitvoeren van regelmatige rapporten en data-analyses. Je vertaalt de aanvragen uit businessafdelingen (Marketing, Distributie, Risk, Finance) naar gedetailleerde data requirements.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen en onderhouden van de onderliggende datastructuren die als basis dienen voor rapporten en analyses. Hiervoor werk je samen met data engineers en maak je gebruik van SQL, SAS en Python. Daarnaast ontwikkel je visuele rapportages in de vorm van dashboards, met behulp van de tool QlikSense.

In samenwerking met het Data Governance-team zorg je voor de harmonisatie en centralisatie van dataconcepten, definieer je duidelijke rollen (Owners, Stewards,), en voer je kwaliteitscontroles uit om de betrouwbaarheid van de data te waarborgen.

Jij hoeft geen witte raaf te zijn

Al kan je er bij ons wel één worden. Bij ons mag je volop je vleugels uitslaan indien je voldoet aan de volgende voorwaarden:


Een diploma STEM (Wetenschappen, Technologie, Engineering, Wiskunde) of economische/commerciële wetenschappen hebt en/of relevante ervaring.
Enkele jaren ervaring in rapporteringen en data-analyses.
Voldoende kennis van SQL en inzicht in datamodellen.
Communicatievaardigheden en in staat bent om zelfstandig te werken.



Je scoort extra met:


Tweetaligheid (Nederlands-Frans), met een goede kennis van het Engels.
Ervaring in Python en Azure Synapse Analytics.
Inzicht in de wereld van verzekeringen.



Belfius koestert zijn talenten

Behalve de kans om elke dag te shinen, bieden wij jou een fulltime contract van onbepaalde duur met:


Een mooi loon aangevuld met een innovatief aanbod om een persoonlijk budget samen te stellen dat je kan besteden volgens je voorkeuren (bv. wagen, fiets, pc, smartphone, tablet, huisvesting onder bepaalde voorwaarden) en extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, personeelsvoordeel op eigen producten en diensten, en een hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering.
Mogelijkheden te over om je te ontwikkelen door een brede waaier aan opleidingen en carrièrekansen in de hele Belfius-groep.
Een goede werk-privé balans dankzij flexibele uren, de combinatie kantoor- en thuiswerk en een aantrekkelijk aantal vakantiedagen.
Een moderne werkplek in het hart van Brussel met een coole fitness, een lekker gezond restaurant en gezellige ontmoetingsruimtes, dit alles op wandelafstand van de winkelstraat, het treinstation Brussel-Noord en de metrohalte Rogier.

Nous sommes le premier industriel de la donnée en Europe. Notre métier est de créer, manager et exploiter le patrimoine data de nos clients.

Une JEMS Académie au service de votre montée en compétences (formations et certifications sur les technologies de pointe)
Un accompagnement personnalisé et un management de proximité pour vous proposer des évolutions de carrière
Une intégration dans des communautés techniques et de pratiques JEMS (encadrement par des experts, échanges sur les bonnes pratiques, favoriser l'innovation...)
Une entreprise reconnue "Great Place To Work"
Des évènements et séminaires inoubliables, des soirées d'agence conviviales


Mobilité

Une mobilité nationale et internationale pour vous accompagner dans vos projets de vie.

Le Groupe JEMS porte fièrement sa valeur "Diversité" en se mobilisant pour l'inclusion et l'égalité des chances et en luttant contre toutes formes de discrimination.

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Accroître la connaissance de la clientèle d’une entreprise, conduire des études sur les bases de données, suivre les outils datamining pour analyser l’impact des actions marketing

MS Office

Des outils de datavisualisation
La préparation de données


Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieur ou d’un parcours universitaire technique. Vous justifiez d’au minimum 3 ans d’expérience professionnelle en tant que Data Analyst.

Title: Corporate Data Analist
Description:
Onze klant, een toonaangevende en mensgerichte organisatie gespecialiseerd in dienstverlening voor ondernemers, zoekt een Corporate Data Analist om complexe data te vertalen naar strategische groei. In deze rol combineer je technische expertise met business-inzicht om de digitale maturiteit en operationele efficiëntie van de organisatie direct te beïnvloeden.

Responsibilities

Je werkt nauw samen met corporate diensten, data engineers en data architects om de vertaalslag te maken van ruwe data naar waardevolle sturingsinformatie. Je rapporteert over de voortgang van de analytics roadmap en adviseert stakeholders op basis van jouw bevindingen.


In kaart brengen van businessbehoeften en deze vertalen naar relevante analyses, dashboards en datagedreven inzichten ter ondersteuning van strategische beslissingen.
Ontwikkelen, testen en optimaliseren van dataproducten die trends, opportuniteiten en risico’s visualiseren voor het management.
Beheren van de prioriteiten binnen de analytics roadmap, rekening houdend met budgetten, GDPR, security en technische haalbaarheid.
Bewaken van de datakwaliteit en consistentie door het toepassen van standaarden en kwaliteitscontroles.
Omzetten van data-inzichten naar concrete beleidsaanbevelingen voor de verdere uitbouw van de organisatie.
Opvolgen van innovaties binnen data en analytics om processen en besluitvorming continu te professionaliseren.


Requirements


Je beschikt over een masterdiploma in een analytische richting of bent gelijkwaardig door relevante werkervaring.
Je hebt sterke ervaring met het modelleren van datasets en het bouwen van rapportages in Power BI.
Je beschikt over een diepgaande kennis van DAX om complexe logica te vertalen naar gebruiksvriendelijke dashboards.
Je hebt ervaring in het samenwerken met diverse stakeholders en kunt vlot schakelen tussen business-noden en technische IT-oplossingen.
Je bent in staat om complexe materie begrijpelijk over te brengen aan verschillende doelgroepen.
Je bent kritisch, nieuwsgierig en proactief ingesteld om verbeterpotentieel binnen de organisatie te detecteren.
Je beschikt over uitstekende organisatorische vaardigheden om diverse projecten en deadlines efficiënt te beheren.
Je bent communicatief vaardig en vloeiend in het Nederlands.
Affiniteit met data-architectuur en databeveiliging is een pluspunt.


Offer


Contract: vast contract van onbepaalde duur.
Extra-legale voordelen: bedrijfswagen met laadpas en laadinstallatie, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, cadeaucheques, hospitalisatieverzekering, pensioenfonds, loonbonus en een flexibel verloningssysteem (o.a. fietsleasing).
Arbeidsregime: voltijds (38u) met een glijdend uurrooster.
Werkmodel: hybride (telewerk mogelijk na de inwerkperiode).
Vakantie: 32 vakantiedagen bij een voltijdse tewerkstelling.
Opleiding: uitgebreid aanbod aan e-learnings en georganiseerde opleidingen voor persoonlijke groei.

Title: DATA ANALYST (LIEGE-BELGIUM)
Description:
THE SCOPE

With 30 years of history, today Gaming1 is one of the international leaders in both land-based and online games of chance (casino games, sports betting and poker). Its evolution at the heart of innovation is accompanied by a diversification and specialization of positions, with the creation of new cutting-edge jobs.

YOUR ROLE

Answering business questions on your player journey with rigorous, well-structured analyses, from data extraction to the final recommendation.
Building and maintaining the dashboards and reports (Power BI) that your Area relies on day to day, with attention to accuracy and clarity.
Digging into player behavior — funnels, drop-offs, retention, segmentation — to understand not just what happened, but why.
Contributing to explorations and Proof of Concepts (including AI) alongside more experienced analysts, to test hypotheses and qualify new approaches.
Turning your findings into clear, visual deliverables (insight notes, dashboards) that decision-makers can act on directly.
Working closely with the Head Of, PM, Data Engineers & Data Scientists of your Area, and progressively building that relationship yourself.
Learning the business inside out: the player journey, the products, the operational realities behind the numbers.

Your mindset

You are curious by nature and genuinely want to understand how things work, rather than simply producing the requested output.
You enjoy formulating hypotheses, confronting them with reality, and accepting when facts contradict your initial assumptions.
You ask questions when something doesn't add up, and you are comfortable saying you don't know yet.
You don't just deliver a report; you want to understand the actual friction behind player behavior and its root causes.
You take feedback well and turn it into progress — you want to grow fast, and you know that means being challenged.
You care about the quality and reliability of your work, and you document what you build.
You thrive in a team environment and interact daily with various departments to refine your understanding of business reality.

YOUR PROFILE

Typically, 1 to 3 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence or a related analytical role — or a strong first experience such as an internship or a significant academic project.
Solid SQL skills: you are comfortable writing joins, aggregations and window functions, and eager to grow towards production-grade queries.
Hands-on experience with a data visualization tool (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) and a willingness to deepen your expertise in semantic modelling and DAX.
Familiarity with data modelling fundamentals (star schema, basic data quality principles) and an appetite for structured, reproducible work.
Some exposure to Python for analytical work (data wrangling, exploratory analysis) is a plus.
An interest in customer or player behavioral data — funnels, retention, segmentation — and in the business questions behind them.
Professional proficiency in English.
A degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

What We Offer

As well as enjoying a unique experience – centered around our values of Pleasure, Team Spirit, Performance, Boldness and Integrity – alongside 1.600 colleagues worldwide, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to the international development of a fast-growing family company.

Joining Gaming1 means becoming part of a human and entrepreneurial adventure where people are empowered to make an impact, grow and succeed together.

We offer:

the opportunity to work on ambitious international projects within a solid and growing group
a collaborative and high-performing work environment
leadership based on trust, autonomy, talent and shared values
continuous learning and career development opportunities through training and internal mobility
a competitive salary and benefits package aligned with the local market
a hybrid working model, with the possibility to work remotely up to 50% of your working time
an international and collaborative environment where people come first

Title: Data Analyst - Aftermarket
Description:
Are you passionate about data, dashboards, and translating numbers into meaningful business insights?

Do you enjoy working with Power BI and helping teams make smarter decisions?

Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

We are looking for a motivated Data Analyst to strengthen our Aftermarket team. In this role, you will help transform data into actionable insights that support business performance, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence across our aftermarket activities.

Whether you are a recent graduate or have already gained some experience, we offer the opportunity to develop your analytical skills in an international and dynamic environment.




What can you expect from this challenging role?

As a Data Analyst within the Aftermarket department, you will collect, analyze, and visualize data related to spare parts sales, inventory, service performance, and business operations. Your insights will help stakeholders identify opportunities, monitor performance, and support strategic decision-making.

Data Analysis & Insights

Collect, cleanse, and analyze data from various aftermarket systems and data sources.
Identify trends, patterns, and opportunities within sales, inventory, service, and operational data.
Translate complex datasets into clear and actionable business insights.
Support data-driven decision-making across the Aftermarket organization.

Dashboarding & Reporting

Develop and maintain interactive dashboards and reports in Power BI.
Monitor and report on key business KPIs.
Create impactful visualizations that help stakeholders quickly understand business performance.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across reports.

Business Intelligence & Process Improvement

Support the continuous improvement of reporting processes and data quality.
Help automate recurring reports and analytical processes.
Contribute to the development of standardized reporting frameworks and KPI structures.
Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through data and analytics.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Work closely with colleagues from Aftermarket, Parts Sales, Service, Supply Chain, and Finance.
Gather business requirements and translate them into reporting and dashboard solutions.
Present findings and recommendations in a clear and understandable way.
Support strategic and operational projects with data analysis and performance tracking.




Are you the new colleague we are looking for?

You have a strong interest in data analytics, reporting, and business intelligence.
You have knowledge of Power BI and data visualization principles.
You are comfortable working with Excel and large datasets.
Experience as a Data Analyst is a plus, but not required.
Recent graduates are encouraged to apply.
You have an analytical mindset and enjoy solving problems using data.
You are eager to learn and continuously develop your technical skills.
You can translate business needs into meaningful reports and insights.
You have strong communication skills and enjoy collaborating with different stakeholders.
You are fluent in English and Dutch.

Nice to have

Knowledge of Power Query, DAX, SQL, or other data analytics tools.
Interest in aftermarket, spare parts, service operations, or supply chain processes.
Experience gained through internships, academic projects, or personal projects involving dashboarding and analytics.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Every organisation is sitting on data, but only a few actually turn it into better decisions. That's where you come in, as someone who can translate raw numbers into clear insights that people understand and act on.




At Darwind, we don't fit consultants into projects, we look for the project that fits you. You'll join a community of Darwinders who value autonomy, ownership, and genuine professional growth, and who believe the best work experience should always be the next one.




Start date: January 2027. Graduating this winter or ready to make your first move into consultancy in the new year? Then the timing is right.




What you will do

As a Junior Data Analyst, you'll support our clients in making sense of their data, while learning alongside experienced Darwinders and a dedicated coach.

Collect, clean and structure data from different sources so it's reliable and ready for analysis
Write SQL queries to extract and combine the data your stakeholders need
Build and maintain dashboards and reports in Power BI, keeping them clear and user-friendly
Analyse trends, spot anomalies and turn your findings into concrete recommendations
Work closely with business teams to understand their questions and translate them into data requirements
Present your insights to non-technical audiences in a way that makes them easy to act on
Document data flows, definitions and reporting logic so your work stays transparent and reusable
Contribute ideas to improve data quality and automate recurring reporting tasks
Learn from senior colleagues on the project and grow your technical and consulting skills step by step




Who you are

We look beyond the CV. For us, motivation and curiosity matter just as much as the technical box-ticking, but to thrive in this role, you'll likely recognise yourself in most of the following:

You hold a master's degree in a quantitative field such as economics, business engineering, statistics, computer science, data science or similar
You have 0 to 2 years of experience, and an internship, thesis or student project involving data definitely counts
You have a basic knowledge of SQL, or you're eager to master it quickly
You've worked with Power BI, Tableau or a similar visualisation tool, even if only during your studies
You're comfortable in Excel, and knowledge of Python or R is a plus
You're analytical and precise, and you like getting to the bottom of a question
You can explain what the numbers mean in plain language
You're curious, proactive and not afraid to ask questions or take initiative
You're fluent in Dutch and have a good command of English, French is a plus




What we offer

Competitive benefits package

Hospitalization insurance
Group insurance
Meal allowance
Your choice between a company car with EU fuel card or the federal mobility budget

Flexibility and work-life balance

Hybrid work possibilities
Flexible working hours
Projects that match your skills and ambitions, not the other way around

Learning and growth

Continuous coaching

Room to grow across different domains and technologies

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Location: Brussels, Belgium

Company: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) Belgium

Employment Type: Full-time




Nature of the Tasks

Collect and clean data from various sources.
Analyse datasets to identify trends and patterns.
Create interactive dashboards and reports that utilize data storytelling to effectively present findings, with defined refresh cadences and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for key deliverables.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data needs.
Develop and maintain data dashboards and reporting tools that provide intuitive access to key metrics and insights, supported by clear documentation and update schedules.
Perform statistical analysis to support decision making.
Ensure data accuracy and consistency through the implementation of data quality checks, validation rules, and regular reconciliation processes with source systems.
Conduct exploratory data analysis to uncover insights.
Document methodologies and analysis processes.
Recommend improvements based on data insights.
Partner with Data Engineers on data modelling (e.g., star/snowflake schemas) and contribute to a centralized definitions and metrics catalogue.
Present data-driven insights and create actionable, decision-oriented recommendations tailored for non-technical audiences and stakeholders.
Write complex Structured Query Language (SQL) queries for data extraction and transformation, and optimize them for performance and efficiency.




Specific Expertise and Technologies

Knowledge of data analysis and manipulation using SQL, Python, or R to extract, transform, and analyse structured and unstructured datasets.
Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Qlik, Microsoft Fabric) to design interactive dashboards and reports.
Knowledge of statistical analysis methods and tools (e.g., SPSS, R, Python libraries) to support evidence-based insights.
Familiarity with spreadsheet tools, especially Microsoft Excel.
Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and platforms (e.g., star/snowflake schemas, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, BigQuery) to support scalable reporting.
Knowledge of data preparation and transformation tools (e.g., Alteryx, Power Query, dbt) to ensure clean and reliable datasets.
Ability to work with large datasets and databases.
Awareness of basic machine learning algorithms (e.g., regression, clustering, classification) to support advanced analytics in collaboration with data scientists.
Knowledge of ETL processes and orchestration tools (e.g., SSIS, Informatica, Talend, Azure Data Factory) to support data pipelines.
Knowledge of cloud-based data services (e.g., Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse) to enable scalable and modern analytics.
Knowledge of data quality practices (e.g., validation rules, reconciliation, lineage tracking) to ensure accuracy and consistency of insights.
Knowledge of metadata and cataloguing tools (e.g., Azure Purview, Collibra) to support data governance and discoverability.




Minimum Level of Expertise

Junior for analysts supporting a senior team.
Normal for standalone Data Analysts accountable for business domains.

Certification and/or Standards

Optional for 'Junior' level:

A certification directly related to the requested profile.

Optional for 'Normal' level and above:

Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate
Microsoft Azure Data Engineer Associate
Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate
Fabric Data Engineer Associate
Or an equivalent certification




Skills

Ability to analyse datasets, detect trends, and deliver evidence-based insights.
Skill in presenting findings with visuals and storytelling that support decisions.
Commitment to maintaining accuracy, consistency, and integrity in reporting.
Ability to resolve data issues and propose actionable improvements.
Competence in managing tasks and delivering insights on time.
Drive to explore new methods, tools, and data sources proactively.
Ability to interpret analytical findings to tell a compelling story that clearly prescribes business actions and drives strategic decision-making.
Flexibility to adopt new data platforms, tools, and approaches.
Ability to frame insights into narratives that support decisions.
Ability to participate in multilingual meetings.
Ability to understand, speak, and write English, optionally French as an additional asset.
Excellent interpersonal skills.
Ability to work in a team as well as autonomously.
Results-oriented mindset, focused on delivering.
Ability to present insights concisely for senior decision-makers.

HTML:
To further strengthen our Modern Data Platform Practice, we are currently looking for a skilled Data Insights Analyst.


Do you enjoy bridging the gap between business and data? Are you passionate about turning data into actionable insights and helping stakeholders make better decisions? Do you have hands-on experience with Power BI and SQL, and do you enjoy investigating complex datasets to uncover the story behind the numbers?


If so, send us your CV and we’ll contact you for an interview and a cup of coffee.


Your responsibilities

  • Support business stakeholders in their journey towards a more data-driven way of working by translating data into actionable insights;
  • Gather, understand, and challenge business requirements to ensure reporting and analytics solutions address the right business needs;
  • Develop, maintain, and improve reporting and analytics solutions using tools like Power BI and SQL;
  • Analyze large and complex datasets while ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of reporting outputs;
  • Investigate data discrepancies, identify root causes, validate business logic, and assess business impact;
  • Act as a bridge between business and technical teams to ensure successful delivery of data and reporting solutions;
  • Understand the value of data within the broader business context and help stakeholders leverage data more effectively.


Your qualifications

  • You have at least 2 years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Reporting, Functional Analysis, or a similar data-focused role;
  • You have strong hands-on experience with SQL and Power BI;
  • You are fluent in speaking both Dutch and English;
  • You have experience gathering and understanding business requirements;
  • You like to interact with and guide businesspeople towards a solution generating business impact;
  • You have an analytical mindset, good communication and interpersonal skills;
  • Proven success in contributing to a team-oriented environment


Our offer

  • A highly entrepreneurial team;
  • A no-nonsense working environment with a focus on high quality;
  • Excellent terms of employment (including company car, fuel card, meal vouchers & bonus);
  • Fringe benefits including continuous training that builds and extends professional, technical and management skills in all areas;
  • The opportunity to grow together with Datashift in terms of capabilities as well as financial benefits.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Maak impact met data op het onderwijs van morgen

Wil jij met data bijdragen aan beter onderwijs? Als Data Analist bij VAN IN vertaal je businessvragen naar inzichten en dataproducten die gebruikt worden voor commerciële, operationele en strategische besluitvorming.

Je krijgt veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid en werkt met een moderne data stack, waaronder Snowflake, dbt, GitHub en Power BI. Tegelijk krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen analytics, AI en dataproductontwikkeling.

Jouw team

Je wordt onderdeel van het Analytics BENE-team, waarin collega's uit België en Nederland samenwerken aan analytics, inzichten en dataproducten.

Je werkt voornamelijk voor VAN IN in Wommelgem en helpt collega's om data optimaal te benutten en steeds meer datagedreven te werken. Je combineert werken vanuit Wommelgem met thuiswerk en bent enkele keren per maand aanwezig bij Malmberg in 's-Hertogenbosch om samen te werken met je Nederlandse collega's.

Wat ga je doen?


Businessvragen vertalen naar analyses, KPI's en datavereisten.
Data verzamelen, transformeren en modelleren vanuit verschillende bronnen.
Dashboards, rapportages en dataproducten ontwikkelen in onder andere Power BI.
Inzichten vertalen naar concrete aanbevelingen voor stakeholders en management.
Datakwaliteit, governance en betrouwbaarheid helpen bewaken.
Business teams ondersteunen in het gebruik van data en dashboards.
Meebouwen aan self-service analytics, het dataplatform en nieuwe AI-toepassingen.
Bijdragen aan de datageletterdheid binnen VAN IN door kennis te delen en datagedreven werken te stimuleren.


Wat breng je mee?


Bachelor- of masterniveau, of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
Bij voorkeur 2 tot 4 jaar ervaring in data-analyse, business intelligence of insights.
Ervaring met Power BI en dashboardontwikkeling.
Ervaring met SQL voor datatransformatie, datamodellering en analyses.
Je kunt complexe data vertalen naar heldere inzichten en concrete aanbevelingen voor de business.
Je bent communicatief sterk en kunt verschillende stakeholders meenemen in je adviezen.
Je bent proactief, neemt eigenaarschap en bent nieuwsgierig om bij te leren.


Een plus


Ervaring met Snowflake, dbt, GitHub of Python.
Ervaring met een moderne cloud dataomgeving.


Wat bieden wij?


Veel vrijheid, eigenaarschap en verantwoordelijkheid.
Een moderne analyticsomgeving met Snowflake, dbt, GitHub en Power BI.
De kans om te werken met nieuwe AI-technologieën voor analyse, automatisering en productiviteit.
Ruimte om mee te bouwen aan self-service analytics en nieuwe dataproducten.
Samenwerking met ervaren data professionals in België en Nederland.
Ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling.
Hybride en flexibel werken: thuis, vanuit ons kantoor in Wommelgem en enkele keren per maand vanuit Malmberg in 's-Hertogenbosch.
En natuurlijk hoort daar ook een mooi pakket bij: een aantrekkelijk salaris met mooie groeimogelijkheden en verschillende extralegale voordelen.


Enthousiast geworden om als Data Analist mee te bouwen aan de verdere datagedreven toekomst van VAN IN? Solliciteer dan eenvoudig via de sollicitatieknop.

Heb je nog vragen over de functie of het sollicitatieproces? Neem gerust contact op met Laura Michiels via laura.michiels@sanoma.com.

Title: Data Analyst / BI Expert Sparen & Betalen
Description:
Ben jij gepassioneerd door data, heb je een analytische geest en ga je graag op zoek naar verbanden? Dan ben jij de persoon die we zoeken om onze resultaten te optimaliseren en onze strategieën verder te ontwikkelen!

Welkom in het team

Als data analist zorg je mee voor een visie, strategie en praktische oplossingen voor datagebruik en data-evolutie binnen de directie Sparen & Betalen. Zo zorg je ervoor dat alle activiteiten en beslissingen gerelateerd aan deze afdeling kunnen gebeuren op basis van kwalitatieve, toegankelijke data.

Jouw rol in het team:


Je verzamelt en definieert datanoden om zo input te geven voor de datastrategie en -visie. Deze strategie zal ons toelaten om projecten te lanceren en bij te sturen zodat Argenta meer toekomstgericht kan evolueren.
Je onderzoekt en ontwikkelt oplossingen die het hele management voorzien van nuttige data om meer datagedreven beslissingen te kunnen nemen.
Je bouwt gesimplificeerde en vooraf berekende datamarts om de business snel toegang te geven tot kwaliteitsvolle data en analyses en zo de rapportering te versnellen.
Als data analist draag je bij aan boeiende data science initiatieven.
Je activeert een (proactieve) data driven cultuur om de strategie van operaties binnen Argenta naar een hoger niveau te tillen.


Argenta en jij: een match?

Als je bij Argenta komt werken, word je Argentaan. Maar Argentaan zijn is meer dan een job hebben bij Argenta.

Bij alles wat je doet, verlies je nooit onze focuswaarden uit het oog: we werken samen, in alle eenvoud, voor onze klanten.

Dat doe je met kennis van zaken, en altijd met twee voeten op de grond. Als Argentaan geef je elke dag opnieuw het beste van jezelf. Je komt terecht in een veilige omgeving waarin je fouten mag maken. En waarin we elkaar durven uitdagen en feedback geven. We zijn ambitieus en leggen de lat hoog. Door elkaar te helpen raken we samen over die lat. Zo maken we een positief verschil voor onze medewerkers, onze klanten en de samenleving.

Wees gerust: bij Argenta kun je gewoon jezelf zijn. Jouw talenten en ambities staan centraal. Groeien en samen winnen, daar gaan we voor.

Jouw loonpakket


Een aantrekkelijk brutoloon
Maaltijdcheques
Groepsverzekering
Hospitalisatieverzekering
Netto onkostenvergoeding van 165 euro per maand
Een cafetariaplan waarmee je het bedrag van je 13de maand flexibel kunt inzetten om aan voordelige voorwaarden bijvoorbeeld een smartphone te leasen of extra verlofdagen aan te kopen
Keuze tussen een bedrijfswagen (inclusief tankkaart of laadoplossing) of een aantrekkelijk mobiliteitsbudget dat je kunt spenderen aan duurzame mobiliteitsalternatieven, zoals de aankoop van een fiets, het gebruik van een deelauto of de terugbetaling van je huisvestingskosten


Extra

Een goede balans tussen werk en privé vinden we even belangrijk als een mooie verloning. Je werkuren vul je dan ook flexibel in. Op kantoor of thuis werken? Jij kiest. Je werkt gemiddeld 60% van thuis uit.

Jouw troeven

Zin in de job? Voel je de match? Check nog even of je ook de juiste ingesteldheid en achtergrondkennis hebt en ga ervoor.


Je hebt een masterdiploma op zak en hebt reeds ervaring in een relevante functie.
Je voelt je comfortabel als brug tussen business en data. Je kan de noden van onze business partners gemakkelijk vertalen naar de nodige datarapportage en dashboards.
Je bent communicatief en legt gemakkelijk connectie met de nodige stakeholders.
Je hebt kennis van Tableau, SQL of gelijkaardige tools.
Je hebt interesse in Databricks en AI tools.
Raakvlakken met data science schrikken je niet af.
Je bent resultaatgericht, ondernemend en kritisch.
Je hebt een zeer analytische geest en kan daardoor gemakkelijk het datalandschap rationaliseren en optimaliseren.
We zoeken iemand met een passie voor data en een gezonde interesse in het business aspect van de directie Sparen & Betalen.


Heb je nog een vraag?

Stuur gerust een e-mail naar Karine Geurts via jobs@argenta.be.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
As part of its sustained growth, Gaming1 is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join its Lab team.

The Lab drives two kinds of innovation that feed each other.




On one side, a Transversal team reads signals across every player journey to catch cross-area patterns, builds the shared

methodologies and tools the whole Lab relies on, and pushes AI-driven experimentation company-wide.




On the other side, each Data Analyst is a named data partner for an area/journey; You become the owner and expert of your player journey: a driver of the journey, not just a do-er. Your work is anchored to the journey rather than ad-hoc requests, giving

you real depth, real continuity and a genuine seat alongside the Head Of, PM, Data Engineers and Data Scientists of your Area. You anticipate what's coming before it's asked for, spot the friction and opportunities that aren't on the roadmap yet.




YOUR ROLE

Proactively detecting emerging trends, value opportunities, or organizational "blind spots" that have not yet been
formalized.
Analysing complex, ambiguous issues to objectify debates with facts and accelerate high-impact decision-making.
Seek to understand the actual friction behind every player’s behaviour and its root causes — going beyond simply
delivering a report.
Conducting targeted explorations and Proof of Concepts (including AI) to test hypotheses and qualify the potential of
new approaches before industrialization.
Designing visual, convincing deliverables (insight notes, Power BI dashboards, analytical frameworks) that are directly
exploitable by decision-makers.
Collaborating with Head Of, PM, Data Engineers & Data Scientists of your Area; build that relationship and own that
communication




YOUR MINDSET

We are looking for a professional who has moved beyond following instructions to taking initiative and for explorers who
love to make data "talk" to challenge the status quo.
You enjoy formulating hypotheses, confronting them with reality, and accepting when facts contradict your initial
assumptions.
You are not wedded to a routine; you adapt your level of formalism and your tools to the urgency and impact of the
subject.
You don’t just deliver a report; you seek to understand the actual friction behind every player’s behaviour and its root
causes.
You know how to step away from the daily flow to conduct long-term research that will structure the company's future.
You are comfortable making dysfunctions visible and challenging existing solutions.
You thrive in a team environment and interact daily with various departments to refine your understanding of the
business reality




YOUR PROFILE

Typically, 6+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence or a related analytical role, with demonstrated
ownership of analytical products and the ability to lead analytical directions while remaining hands-on
Advanced SQL skills and experience building maintainable, production-grade queries, semantic models and data
products
Strong data visualization tool expertise, including semantic model design, DAX, dataflows, and report governance (e.g.
Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
Solid data modelling practices, including star schema, documentation, data quality standards with a focus on
reproducible and scalable work
Working knowledge of cloud data platforms
Python proficiency for analytical work beyond SQL: statistical analysis, cohort modelling, data wrangling, exploratory
automation and lightweight prototyping
Experience analysing player or customer behavioural data — funnels, retention, journey mapping, segmentation
Professional proficiency in English
A degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent
practical experience







Interested in learning more?

Koda Staff is managing this search exclusively on behalf of GAMING1.

If the role aligns with your experience, or you'd like to explore fit and scope in more detail, applications and confidential conversations are welcome.

Title: Data Analyst (Media Measurement)
Description:
Job Description



Our Media Measurement department delivers robust and independent metrics on audio and video. Our core business is helping media companies by providing them with the right data for audience analysis. We received continuous data from surveys that help our customers to define trends and strategies.



We are now looking for a Data Analyst that can help us with data analysis, consistency and checks. As a media data analyst you set controls that guide us to analyse trends, establish automatized checks, create reports and support our team in daily operations.



Do you have a passion for data and analysis? Do you also have a certain affinity with Media? Then the position of Data Analyst (Media Measurement) is definitely for you.



As a Data Analyst, you have the following important responsibilities:



Manage, consolidate, and maintain media survey data in Excel, ensuring datasets are structured and ready for analysis and reporting
Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of survey data throughout data processing and analysis
Validate survey results and perform quality checks to ensure reliable reporting outputs
Support the production of recurring reports, insights, and client presentations based on survey results
Contribute to the creation and updating of PowerPoint presentations that communicate findings and recommendations to clients
Provide operational support for the day-to-day activities of the Media Measurement Operations team
Maintain effective collaboration and open communication with colleagues, commercial teams, and other stakeholders involved in survey and reporting activities
Continuously identify opportunities to improve processes, reporting workflows, and efficiency in data handling and presentation creation

Requirements:



Solid experience in either data processing/analysis in Excel
University degree
English + NL or FR in spoken and written
Flexible, agile mind-set, generally pro-active and open-minded
A team player
Professional problem-solving skills and enhanced analytical skills
Efficient and effective use of provided tools and applied processes for all established collaboration models and distributed work
Good knowledge of SPSS

Join our team and benefit from the following advantages:



Exciting work environment that brings people together
Use of the latest digital technologies
Initial and ongoing trainings to support your development
Opportunities for personal and professional growth

Title: Commercieel Data Analist
Description:
Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Ben jij iemand die moeiteloos verbanden legt tussen cijfers, marktinformatie en commerciële opportuniteiten? Krijg je energie van analyses die een directe impact hebben op klanten, groei en strategie? Dan is dit jouw kans om data om te zetten in waardevolle inzichten.

Voor een internationaal actieve organisatie binnen de consumer goods-sector zijn we op zoek naar een Commercieel Data Analyst. In deze functie werk je op het kruispunt van sales, marktanalyse en business intelligence en ondersteun je commerciële teams met inzichten die écht het verschil maken.

Als Commercieel & Data Analyst help je commerciële teams om beter onderbouwde beslissingen te nemen. Je brengt data samen uit verschillende bronnen, analyseert trends en vertaalt complexe informatie naar heldere aanbevelingen. Dankzij jouw analyses krijgen accountmanagers, category specialisten en business stakeholders een beter inzicht in markt dynamieken, consumentengedrag en commerciële opportuniteiten.


Je verzamelt en combineert gegevens uit verschillende databronnen zoals verkoopresultaten, marktinformatie, klantdata en promotiecampagnes.
Je analyseert prestaties, evoluties en trends binnen productcategorieën en klantsegmenten.
Je vertaalt cijfers naar concrete aanbevelingen die commerciële groei ondersteunen.
Je levert inzichten aan voor klantgesprekken, strategische business reviews en commerciële presentaties.
Je helpt accountmanagers bij het identificeren van groeikansen en optimalisaties.
Je ondersteunt bij assortimentsanalyses en aanbevelingen voor klanten.


Profiel kandidaat


Je werkt graag met cijfers, rapporteringen en datasets.
Je bent analytisch sterk en denkt kritisch.
Je bent nieuwsgierig en gaat actief op zoek naar verbanden en inzichten.
Je werkt gestructureerd en behoudt overzicht over verschillende projecten tegelijk.
Je hebt interesse in consumentengedrag, retail en commerciële strategie.
Je bent zeer sterk in Excel.
Ervaring met Power BI of andere reportingtools is zeer grote troef.
Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en Engels.


Geboden wordt


Een functie waarin jouw analyses rechtstreeks bijdragen aan commerciële groei en strategische beslissingen.
Veel ruimte om initiatief te nemen en verbeteringen voor te stellen.
Nauw samenwerken met ervaren professionals binnen sales, category management en business operations.
Een internationale werkomgeving waar data een belangrijke rol speelt in de besluitvorming.
De kans om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen business intelligence, commerciële analyse en category management.
Een organisatie waar ondernemerschap, samenwerking en innovatie centraal staan.
Een aantrekkelijk salarispakket aangevuld met extralegale voordelen.
Een omgeving waar jouw inzichten zichtbaar impact hebben op klanten, resultaten en toekomstige groei.
