Title: Finance Data Analyst
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Finance Data Analyst based in Switzerland.

As a Finance Data Analyst, you will transform complex financial and operational data into reliable insights that support strategic decision-making and business performance. You will bridge the gap between Finance and technical teams, ensuring data is consistent, accessible, and actionable. Working across finance, revenue, operations, HR, and cloud infrastructure systems, you will help structure datasets, improve reporting, and automate recurring analyses. You will play a key role in strengthening data quality, standardizing financial metrics, and improving forecasting and performance monitoring. In a fast-evolving, technology-driven environment, you will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to build scalable reporting processes and support future analytical initiatives. This is an opportunity to combine financial expertise, technical skills, and business curiosity to deliver measurable impact.

Accountabilities


Map and document financial and corporate data sources, systems, ownership, definitions, and data flows to improve transparency and consistency.
Identify data gaps, inconsistencies, duplication, and reconciliation issues across accounting, billing, CRM, HR, payroll, cash management, and expense-management systems.
Define data requirements for monthly closing, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting, ensuring key financial and operational metrics are clearly defined and consistently calculated.
Explore, transform, and model data from data warehouses and connected business systems to create reliable, reusable, and well-documented datasets.
Reconcile data across multiple sources and investigate discrepancies to improve the accuracy and reliability of financial and corporate reporting.
Produce recurring financial analyses, dashboards, and reporting to support leadership decisions, including budget-versus-actuals analysis, variance analysis, cash monitoring, headcount planning, and SaaS performance analysis.
Collaborate with data engineering teams and system owners to improve integrations, transformations, data accessibility, and quality checks.
Automate recurring reporting, reconciliations, and analytical workflows where automation can deliver meaningful efficiency gains.
Maintain documentation covering data lineage, metric definitions, business rules, assumptions, and known limitations.
Contribute to data governance and quality monitoring, preparing reliable datasets for forecasting, anomaly detection, and future AI-driven use cases.
Handle confidential financial, HR, and payroll information with discretion, accuracy, and a strong commitment to data protection.


Requirements


At least 3 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, financial analytics, FP&A analytics, or a related analytical role.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate data across multiple systems and identify the root causes of discrepancies.
Good command of SQL and practical experience with at least one business intelligence or data visualization tool.
Ability to translate business questions into clear data requirements, meaningful metrics, and actionable analyses.
Solid understanding of financial concepts, including budgeting, forecasting, monthly closing, variance analysis, revenue, cash flow, costs, and unit economics.
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including the ability to review, audit, and structure existing financial models.
Strong documentation and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both Finance and technical stakeholders.
Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken, and the ability to communicate complex findings clearly.
A rigorous, curious, and structured approach to data quality, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and make definitions explicit.
Ability to work independently, prioritize competing requests, and deliver practical solutions in a changing business environment.


Nice-to-have Qualifications


Experience in a B2B SaaS, software, technology, or scale-up environment.
Familiarity with SaaS revenue metrics, including MRR, ARR, NRR, churn, and bookings.
Understanding of SaaS cost structures, including cloud storage, compute, data retention, AI-related expenses, and gross margin.
Experience with finance, accounting, billing, CRM, HRIS, payroll, expense-management, or financial planning tools.
Knowledge of data warehouses, data modeling, ETL processes, APIs, or data quality frameworks.
Experience with Python or another programming language for analysis and automation.
Previous exposure to sensitive HR or payroll data and an understanding of the confidentiality requirements involved.


Candidates who meet most, but not necessarily all, of these requirements are encouraged to apply. A strong willingness to learn, analytical thinking, and the ability to demonstrate relevant skills are equally valued.

Benefits


Full-time employment in a role with meaningful exposure to financial strategy and business performance.

Title: Data Analyst (H/F)
Description:
Pour notre division Production, nous recherchons un(e) Data Analyst dont la mission principale sera de transformer les données en indicateurs fiables, accessibles et intuitifs, afin de fournir aux équipes des leviers concrets pour piloter efficacement leur performance au quotidien.

Responsabilités


Être l’interlocuteur privilégié des métiers pour recueillir, analyser et prioriser leurs besoins en indicateurs et en reporting.
Exploiter des données issues de sources variées — ERP, PLM, MES, LES, bases de données et équipements — afin de produire des analyses utiles à la décision.
Concevoir, prototyper et déployer des tableaux de bord Tableau fiables, performants et harmonisés.
Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes IT pour développer, automatiser et pérenniser les sources et flux de données.
Garantir la cohérence et la fiabilité des indicateurs, dans le respect des règles métier et des formules de calcul harmonisées.
Participer à une dynamique inter-sites en réutilisant, adaptant ou co-construisant des indicateurs et reportings partagés.
Piloter le déploiement des reportings sur votre périmètre, accompagner les utilisateurs dans leur prise en main et favoriser leur autonomie.
Documenter les solutions mises en place et contribuer à diffuser les bonnes pratiques data auprès des équipes.


Profil


Diplôme d’Ingénieur HES, EPF ou d’une formation équivalente.
Passionné(e) par la donnée, à l’aise dans l’échange avec les métiers et motivé(e) par la création de solutions concrètes à fort impact opérationnel.
Maîtrise des outils de traitement et d’analyse de données tels que Python, Tableau Prep, KNIME, DATAIKU ou équivalent.
Bonne maîtrise de Tableau, des bases de données et des environnements de Business Intelligence.
Vous savez transformer des problématiques métiers en analyses et solutions de reporting claires, pertinentes et actionnables.
Intérêt marqué pour le développement de tableaux de bord, le prototypage, la qualité et la valorisation des données.
Autonomie, rigueur, bon sens de l’organisation et capacité à gérer les priorités.
Dynamique, flexible et doté(e) d’un fort esprit d’équipe


Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant, d’excellentes conditions de travail et des prestations sociales de premier ordre.

Nous vous remercions d'adresser un dossier de candidature complet (CV, lettre de motivation, certificats et diplômes).

Title: Data Analyst / BI Expert, 80-100%
Description:
Vous êtes formé-e aux sciences informatiques et avez un talent pour faire parler les données ? Rejoignez-nous en tant que Data Analyst, vous serez au cœur de projets innovants et transversaux, porteurs de la transformation numérique de la BCVS.




Concrètement ?

Vos responsabilités vous mèneront à échanger avec les utilisateurs-trices, à analyser leurs besoins et à les soutenir dans la prise en main de nouveaux outils. Votre savoir-faire et votre pédagogie permettront des prises de décisions optimales par les managers. Dans le développement de solutions, vous collaborerez donc aux ateliers de conception avec le métier.
Vous participerez activement aux développements technologiques dans la gestion des données ; en particulier la mise en place des rapports, ainsi que les flux et la plateforme d’analyse de données elle-même. Vous analyserez, modéliserez et créerez les datamarts et les flux ETL ; par ce biais, vous serez une force de proposition dans l’apport de solutions innovantes.
Dans le cadre du cycle de projets, vous assurerez le suivi en production et rédigerez la documentation technique.




Le défi vous tente ?

Ce poste est fait pour vous si…

Vous disposez d’une formation supérieure dans le domaine informatique (EPFL, HES ou équivalent) et disposez de plusieurs années d'expérience à un poste similaire (la connaissance du secteur bancaire serait un atout).
Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques, notamment ODI, SAP BO, Power BI ou Databricks, et possédez de bonnes aptitudes rédactionnelles.
Personne impliquée et proactive, votre métier vous passionne et vous suivez les dernières tendances du secteur.
Votre maîtrise de l’allemand constitue un atout.




Rencontrons-nous !

Vous souhaitez nous rejoindre ? Nous nous réjouissons de découvrir votre candidature.

Pour ce faire, envoyez votre dossier complet à l’adresse : recrutement@bcvs.ch.

Title: Senior Specialist - HD Analytics & Reporting
Description:
In Short

Our Happiness Delivery (HD) team is growing, and we are looking for an Analytics & Reporting Senior Specialist to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights.

You will sit at the intersection of business, analytics and data engineering, helping HD understand its performance, improve how we use data and identify opportunities to work smarter through automation and technology.

This is not just a reporting role. You will be a curious problem solver and trusted analytics partner who can move from a business question to the underlying data, understand what is happening, and translate the answer into a simple and actionable story for the right audience.

Your Mission


Own the Performance Narrative: Design, build and maintain dashboards and reporting that provide a clear view of HD performance across regions, channels and processes. Ensure that metrics are accurate, relevant and presented at the right level of granularity for different stakeholders.
Turn Business Questions into Insights: Partner with HD leadership and operational teams to understand their questions and translate them into meaningful analysis, KPIs and reporting. Go beyond reporting what happened to help explain why it happened and what we should do about it.
Bridge Business and Data Engineering: Act as a strong link between HD and Data Engineering / Business Intelligence teams. Translate business needs into clear data requirements, help clarify priorities and investigate issues when reporting or data does not behave as expected.
Look Beyond the Dashboard: You are comfortable going deeper into the data pipeline when necessary. You will investigate data quality issues, understand how data is transformed, identify gaps or inconsistencies and provide recommendations on where the underlying data or processes can be improved.
Continuously Improve: Challenge existing ways of working and identify opportunities to simplify reporting, automate flows, improve data structures, reduce manual effort and strengthen the overall analytics landscape. Help the team move from reactive reporting towards scalable, proactive analytics.


Your Story


Analytical Experience: You have 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, performance management, customer service, CRM, operations or a related field. Experience in customer service is a strong plus, and you understand the importance of translating operational performance into actionable insights.
Strong Technical Foundation: You are highly proficient in SQL and comfortable working with data logic and transformations. You can investigate data beyond the reporting layer and understand how data flows through a pipeline. Experience with LookML is desirable, and Python is a plus.
BI & Data Visualization: You have strong hands-on experience with BI and visualization tools. You understand not only how to build dashboards, but how to structure information and visualizations so that complex performance can be communicated clearly to different audiences. Experience with Looker and HEX is a strong plus.
AI & Automation Mindset: You are curious about AI and modern automation technologies and naturally look for opportunities to eliminate manual work, improve processes and scale analytics. Experience measuring or working with AI/automation initiatives, such as automation rates, model accuracy or human intervention, is a plus.
Curious Problem Solver: You enjoy investigating problems rather than accepting the first answer. When a number looks wrong, a process is inefficient or a stakeholder has a difficult question, you are comfortable digging into the data and underlying logic to understand what is really happening.
Business & Technical Translator: You are able to translate business needs into data requirements for engineering teams, while also explaining technical concepts and data limitations in a simple way to business stakeholders.You can challenge assumptions constructively, align different perspectives and turn ambiguous business questions into clear analytical requirements.
Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in engineering, computer science, data analytics, business analytics or a related quantitative field.
Language Skills: Business fluency in English is required.


Your Team

At On, delivering happiness is not just a phrase, it’s a mission. That’s why we call our customer service organization Happiness Delivery.

You will join an entrepreneurial and ambitious team where analytics plays a key role in improving how we serve our customers and operate at scale. You will work closely with HD leadership, operational teams, Analytics & Reporting, Data Engineering and other technology partners across Berlin, Zurich and Portland.

This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on how HD uses data: from strengthening the foundations of our reporting to identifying new opportunities to automate, simplify and improve the customer experience.

FORFIRM is providing solutions to real business challenges for our clients through innovation and deep industry understanding.

At FORFIRM, we are creating a culture where each person can define their own role parameters and speak their mind without hesitation. We are a true meritocracy, where individual results define each person's career path.

We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated Senior Data Analytics Consultant to join our international team and contribute to strategic data and reporting initiatives for leading Swiss and European organizations.

About The Role

The Senior Data Analytics Consultant will act as a trusted advisor for clients and internal stakeholders, supporting the design and implementation of data-driven solutions that enable effective decision-making and business transformation.

The role combines consulting expertise, data modelling capabilities, advanced SQL development, and Business Intelligence competencies. The selected candidate will lead analytical initiatives, interact directly with business stakeholders and management teams, and contribute to the definition of modern data architectures and reporting frameworks.

Responsibilities

Data Analytics & Consulting


Engage with business stakeholders to understand strategic objectives and analytical requirements.
Translate business needs into scalable data and reporting solutions.
Lead workshops, requirement-gathering sessions, and analytical assessments.
Support clients in defining KPI frameworks and performance measurement models.
Act as a trusted advisor for data-driven decision-making initiatives.


Data Modeling & Data Architecture


Design and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models.
Define dimensional data models (Star Schema and Snowflake Schema) supporting enterprise reporting needs.
Collaborate with Data Engineers and Architects to define scalable analytics architectures.
Support data governance, master data management, and data quality initiatives.
Ensure consistency, integrity, and sustainability of analytical data platforms.


SQL Development & Data Analysis


Develop and optimize complex SQL queries and database objects.
Perform advanced data analysis and profiling activities.
Conduct data reconciliation and root cause investigations.
Analyze large datasets to identify trends, anomalies, risks, and opportunities.
Support data migration and transformation initiatives.


Power BI & Business Intelligence


Design and develop enterprise-grade dashboards and reports using Microsoft Power BI.
Develop advanced DAX calculations, KPIs, measures, and semantic models.
Implement reporting best practices and governance standards.
Support executive reporting and management dashboards.
Ensure performance optimization and scalability of reporting solutions.


Leadership & Project Delivery


Act as senior reference point within client engagements.
Coach and mentor junior consultants and analysts.
Collaborate with project managers in defining scope, timelines, and deliverables.
Contribute to proposal preparation and business development activities.
Support pre-sales initiatives related to Data & Analytics services.


WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?


Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Data Science, or a related discipline.
At least 5 years of professional experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing, or related fields.
Strong expertise in SQL development and relational databases.
Solid experience in conceptual, logical, dimensional, and physical data modeling.
Proven experience designing and developing solutions with Microsoft Power BI.
Strong knowledge of DAX, Power Query, and semantic model design.
Experience interacting directly with business stakeholders and senior management.
Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Fluent English and Italian.


NICE TO HAVE


Python for data analysis, automation, and data processing.
Microsoft Fabric.
Azure Data Platform.
Data Warehouse architectures.
ETL / ELT frameworks and tools.
Cloud analytics environments.
Banking or Financial Services experience.
Knowledge of Data Governance, Data Quality, and Regulatory Reporting frameworks.


What We Offer


Opportunity to work on strategic and highly visible projects for major Swiss and international clients.
Exposure to complex Data & Analytics transformation programs.
Meritocratic environment with clear career progression opportunities.
Continuous investment in professional development and certifications.
Dynamic, international, and collaborative working environment.
Participation in the growth of FORFIRM's Data & Analytics practice.

Bist du breit mit uns das Vertrauen im Kartengeschäft zu stärken, in dem wir gemeinsam betrügerische Aktivitäten aufdecken und wirksam stoppen? Dann verstärke unser Fraud Intelligence Team. 

Als Fraud Analyst bist du für die Analyse von betrügerischen Transaktionen verantwortlich und entwickelst gezielte Gegenmassnahmen um Betrugsaktivitäten zu unterbinden.  

 

Das sind deine Aufgaben 
Analyse von betrügerischen Transaktionen und Ermittlung von neuen Fraud Trends 
Erstellen und Anpassen von Regeln in unserem Betrugsfrühwarnsystem 
Aufbereiten von Reports zu Fraud Fällen, Trends und KPIs 
Steuerung Fraud Detection & Prevention (PRISMA) 
Fraud Incident Management bei Fraud Attacken

Starke analytische Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung in der Erkennung neuer Betrugsmuster und Angriffsszenarien. 
Erfahrung im Aufbau, der Optimierung und dem Testing von Fraud-Detection-Regeln und Scoring-Modellen. 
Sehr gute SQL-Kenntnisse sowie praktische Erfahrung mit Python für Datenanalysen und Automatisierungen. 
Fähigkeit, grosse Datenmengen auszuwerten und daraus konkrete Fraud- und Business-Massnahmen abzuleiten. 
Erfahrung mit Fraud-Management-, Case-Management- und Reporting-Plattformen. 
Fundiertes Know-how im Fraud Management und Interesse an innovativen Ansätzen in den Bereichen Analytics, Detection und Prevention 
Ausgezeichnete Deutsch- und Englishkentnisse

Business Data Controlling Expert (m/w/d)

Title: Business Analytics & Insights Manager
Description:
About Sotheby's

Established in 1744, Sotheby’s promotes access and ownership of exceptional art and luxury objects through auctions, private sales and retail. Our deep expertise across 70 selling categories is supported by a leading technology platform and a global network of specialists spanning 40 countries. Selling categories include Contemporary Art, Modern and Impressionist Art, Old Masters, Chinese Works of Art, Jewelry, Watches, Wine and Spirits and Design, as well as collectible cars and real estate through RM Sotheby’s and Concierge. Sotheby’s Financial Services is a leading art lender and provides capital solutions for collectors around the world, having originated more than $12 billion in loans since its inception. Sotheby’s new global headquarters is now open at the iconic Breuer building at 945 Madison Avenue in New York City.

THE ROLE

Working closely with the Head of Luxury Division and the Managing Director Switzerland, the role provides meaningful business insights, performance visibility and strategic reporting to support decision-making across the business. The position acts as an enabler to specialists and leadership teams by translating commercial and client data into actionable intelligence, helping identify trends, opportunities and areas of focus.

Responsibilities

Client Analytics & Growth Insights


Leverage internal client data and CRM tools to provide visibility on client activity, engagement patterns and growth opportunities across categories.
Support specialists and leadership teams by identifying client trends, areas of opportunity and potential cross-category connections.
Contribute to client acquisition and development initiatives through data-driven analysis and actionable insights.
Analyse client acquisition, retention and reactivation trends to support business planning and prioritization.
Develop reporting and insights on key client-related KPIs.
Collaborate with global client strategy teams to share best practices and ensure alignment of methodologies and reporting.


Business Performance Analytics & Reporting


Develop and maintain reporting frameworks, dashboards and KPI tracking tools for the Luxury business.
Provide visibility on performance across auctions, private sales and client development activities.
Produce regular business reviews and performance reporting for the Luxury and Swiss leadership team.
Monitor key performance indicators and highlight trends, opportunities and areas requiring attention.
Conduct pre-sale, during-sale and post-sale analyses to support business discussions and future planning.
Develop auction intelligence reporting and market insights to support decision-making.
Analyse bidding activity, buyer participation, conversion metrics and international selling patterns.
Develop auction and sales performance reporting on the Luxury and Switzerland's contribution to the wider Sotheby's business.
Translate complex business data into actionable insights and recommendations.


Process Improvement, Automation & Data Enablement


Support strategic initiatives aimed at enhancing business visibility, reporting capabilities and operational efficiency.
Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes through automation and AI-enabled solutions.
Partner with P&T teams to improve data accessibility and reporting capabilities.
Support the implementation and adoption of new tools, processes and reporting frameworks.
Contribute to cross-functional projects requiring coordination, analysis and stakeholder engagement.
Help reduce manual reporting activities and improve scalability through process optimisation.


Leadership Reporting & Communications


Prepare executive-level presentations, business reviews and strategic updates for Luxury and Swiss leadership.
Translate complex analyses into clear, concise and actionable business insights.
Produce materials that support leadership discussions, planning and decision-making.
Develop presentation materials for senior management meetings and business reviews.
Facilitate communication across functions to ensure alignment on reporting, priorities and objectives.
Ensure stakeholders have timely access to relevant performance, client and market insights.


Ideal Experience & Competencies


5-8 years’ experience in business analytics, commercial insights, reporting or business intelligence, ideally within luxury, financial services, consulting or a data-driven commercial environment.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations.
Advanced IT skills; experience with CRM platforms and data visualisation tools.
Proven experience building dashboards, KPI frameworks and executive reporting materials.
Strong business acumen with an interest in client behaviour, sales performance and market trends.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, able to influence and engage senior stakeholders.
Proactive, curious and solution-oriented, with a continuous improvement mindset and strong attention to detail.
Fluent in English. Swiss market exposure preferred.

Title: DCX Product Analytics Specialist / Senior Analytics Specialist
Description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our Analytics Solutions team, part of Digital Client Experience at Marsh Risk. This role will be based in Zurich or London.

DCX Product Analytics Specialist / Senior Analytics Specialist

We will count on you to:


Partner with brokers, client executives, product teams, and analytics colleagues to identify risk and renewal pain points and translate them into clear analytical problems and success criteria.
Prepare, clean, and enrich data from multiple sources including exposure, policies, claims, pricing, engineering, and third-party hazard or vendor model data.
Build, assess, and validate analytical models and loss modeling approaches to support Property Risk Quantification, including catastrophe and non-catastrophe use cases, with potential application across other lines of business.
Apply pricing, actuarial, and risk-based techniques to generate actionable insights for loss modeling, portfolio assessment, and business decision-making.
Prototype dashboards, reports, and analytical outputs that translate technical model results into clear, decision-ready guidance for business stakeholders.
Collaborate closely with product, engineering, and data teams to operationalize analytical workflows, improve data foundations, and support scalable analytics solutions.
Document models, assumptions, methodologies, and data lineage in line with governance requirements and support transparent interpretation of model outputs.
Operate effectively in a fast-changing, incubation-style environment where priorities, use cases, and project scope may evolve, helping bring structure and momentum to emerging analytics problems.


What you need to have:


Typically 5–8 years of relevant experience in analytics, actuarial work, catastrophe modeling, pricing, or insurance risk analysis.
Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline such as Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, Data Science, or equivalent practical experience.
Solid understanding of statistical modeling, loss modeling, and model validation, ideally in insurance, pricing, or actuarial contexts.
Experience with catastrophe modeling, Property risk analytics, or related risk quantification approaches, including interpretation and use of model outputs.
Experience working with insurance-related data and tools, with familiarity with platforms such as RMS, AIR/Verisk, or similar analytics and modeling environments considered a plus.
Proficiency in Python and/or SQL for analytics, modeling, and data preparation, with experience in reproducible analytical workflows.
Familiarity with BI and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools to create prototype dashboards and business-ready analytical outputs.


What makes you stand out:


Master’s degree in a quantitative field or progress toward an actuarial qualification.
Experience working in insurance, reinsurance, broking, or risk advisory, particularly in Property cat and non-cat analytics.
Demonstrated ability to translate technical results into actionable business insights and communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-changing, and not fully structured environments, with the ability to create clarity and move work forward.
Product mindset with the ability to shape approaches, refine problem statements, and adapt as priorities evolve in an incubation-style setting.


Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

Title: Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst
Description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst is responsible for analysing business performance and delivering integrated, objective, and actionable insights to support strategic decision-making.

As a key member of the Revenue Management & Sales Services Analytics team, he/she will have the opportunity to work with large-scale datasets and advanced technologies, developing deep expertise in the core business. To succeed in this role, the Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst must have a strong passion for data analysis, reporting, and uncovering meaningful insights. The role requires the ability to interpret complex information, assess business implications, and provide impactful recommendations that drive revenue growth and improve overall business performance.

Your Impact

Reporting directly to the Revenue Management Business Analytics Manager, the Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst will be responsible for:


Supporting the full lifecycle of the budgeting and forecasting processes, ensuring the delivery of accurate and timely analyses.
Partnering with business stakeholders to identify needs, define requirements, and translate them into actionable analytical solutions.
Gathering, documenting, and maintaining data requirements to support both recurring and ad hoc business analyses.
Developing expertise across multiple data sources and business domains to generate meaningful insights and drive informed decision-making.
Collaborating with vendors, third-party providers, and cross-functional corporate teams in a dynamic and agile environment.
Contributing to the continuous enhancement of analytical frameworks, reporting capabilities, and data-driven business processes.


Data Analysis And Insights. Main Activities Include


QA data to ensure accuracy
Analyze and mine data to find opportunities in time allotted
Undertake proactive and reactive ad-hoc requests as needed
Make business recommendations based on the data findings
Drive more efficient and sophisticated analytical insights


Analysis Distribution. Main Activities Include


Design effective and impactful reports and visualizations for both large and small scale distribution
Create presentations to highlight recommendations and tell the story
Ensure partners understand the analysis presented


Analytical Innovation. Main Activities Include


Drive efficiencies to current processes through tools and processes
Increase the level of sophistication of analyses through statistical, machine learning, and artificial intelligence techniques


Your Journey so far


Four plus years of relevant experience in a fast paced, rapidly changing operations environment
Experience with “big data” environments and tool
Experience data and analytics
Experience with budgeting and forecasting processes
Bachelor’s in mathematics, business administration or IT


Your Essentials


Fluent English (Knowledge of a second European language is preferred but not essential)
Excellent analytical skills.
Previous experience in Revenue Management is essential, possibly in the tourism industry.
Ability to build business cases from analysis to be sold to senior management, including Chief Revenue Management and Sales, Executive Directors and CEO.
Strong problem solving and decision-making attitude.
Experience with analytics tools (PYTHON, SAP, ZENZ, QLIK SENSE) would be a strong advantage


Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Title: Retail Business Analytics Manager
Description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Retail Business Analytics Manager is responsible for transforming retail data into actionable business insights that improve commercial performance, inventory productivity and decision-making across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

The role provides analytical leadership across sales performance, profitability, demand planning, inventory optimization and commercial governance.

Working closely with Retail Leadership, Category Managers, Planning teams, Finance, Operations and Digital teams, the role develops the analytical frameworks, dashboards and insights required to optimize assortment, inventory investment and retail performance across the global fleet.

The position acts as a strategic business partner, enabling data-driven decisions and continuous improvement across all retail categories

Your Impact

Business Performance Analytics


Develop and maintain retail performance dashboards covering sales, margin, inventory and productivity indicators.
Provide regular performance analysis by:
Ship
Boutique
Category
Brand
SK
Itinerary
Guest segment
Identify commercial opportunities and performance gaps.
Translate data into clear recommendations and action plans for Retail Leadership and Category teams.


KPI Framework & Reporting


Define and improve the global retail KPI framework, including:
Sales performance
Conversion rate
Average Transaction Value (ATV)
Units Per Transaction (UPT)
Sales per square meter / selling space
Sell-through
Gross margin
Inventory productivity
Stock turn
Create automated reporting tools to improve decision speed and visibility.
Support weekly, monthly and seasonal business reviews.


Demand & Inventory Analytics


Support demand forecasting by SKU, ship, boutique and geographic area.
Analyze sales trends, seasonality, itinerary impact and guest behavior to improve forecasts.
Identify best sellers, slow movers and inventory risks.
Provide recommendations for:
Allocation
Replenishment
Stock balancing
Inventory optimization
Support stock shortage prevention and opportunity capture.


Commercial Control & Profitability


Monitor margin performance and identify improvement opportunities.
Support pricing validation and pricing consistency across categories.
Analyze promotional performance and markdown effectiveness.
Support annual budgeting, forecasting and Open-To-Buy (OTB) governance.
Evaluate profitability by:
Category
Brand
Product
Ship
Boutique


Assortment & Category Insights


Provide analytical support to Category Managers for assortment decisions.
Analyze:
Product productivity
SKU contribution
Collection performance
Brand performance
Price architecture
Identify opportunities to improve assortment depth and efficiency.
Support seasonal assortment reviews and buying decisions.


Inventory Productivity


Monitor inventory health across the fleet.
Identify:
Overstock situations
Stock shortages
Obsolete inventory
Low productivity products
Recommend actions to improve inventory return and cash efficiency.
Support markdown and liquidation decisions when required.


Data Management & Tools


Partner with IT and Digital teams to improve retail data availability and reporting capabilities.
Support the development of future retail systems and analytics solutions.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency and governance.
Contribute to the transition from manual Excel-based reporting toward automated analytics.


Cross Functional Collaboration


Work closely with:
Head of Forecast, Budget and Analytics
Category Managers
Retail Operations
Merchandise Planning
Finance
Supply Chain
IT / Digital teams
Act as a trusted analytical partner supporting commercial decisions


Your Journey so far


5–10 years of experience in retail analytics, merchandise planning, business intelligence or commercial performance.
Experience in luxury retail, fashion, travel retail or multi-store environments.
Strong experience analyzing sales, inventory and profitability data.
Experience building dashboards and performance reporting frameworks.
Experience with retail planning systems, BI tools and advanced Excel.


Your Essentials


Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
Excellent understanding of retail business drivers and commercial KPIs.
Ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations.
Strong understanding of inventory management and merchandise planning principles.
Advanced Excel skills and experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau or equivalent).
Strong communication skills and ability to influence stakeholders.
Business-oriented mindset with attention to operational details.
Ability to work in a fast-moving international environment.

Title: Analytics & Insights Manager
Description:
Join our dynamic corporate team and become part of Aman Group. With offices strategically located around the world (Zug, London, Dubai, Singapore, Bangkok, Miami and New York), our corporate colleagues are at the forefront of driving innovation and excellence for our ultra-luxury brand.

Role:

We are seeking an Analytics & Insights Manager reporting to the Director of Analytics & Insights. Based in our Baar, Switzerland corporate office you will lead data analysis, reporting, and dashboarding across the business. This role will transform complex data into actionable insights, oversee end-to-end data processes, and ensure accuracy across core systems. You will partner closely with cross-functional teams to align on KPIs, support strategic decision-making, and foster a strong data-driven culture.

Responsibilities:


Oversee daily data ingestion, synchronization, and validation processes across internal (CRM, PMS, Finance) and external data sources (vendors, partners, market feeds)
Ensure all data pipelines and manual uploads are executed accurately and on schedule
Coordinate with Data Engineering to troubleshoot data discrepancies, failed loads, or system mismatches
Collaborate with Data Engineering to ensure data readiness, consistency, and governance across CRM, PMS, and ancillary systems
Validate and maintain the integrity of datasets, ensuring alignment with enterprise data standards and with data privacy / compliance / governance requirements
Conduct deep-dive analyses and develop predictive models (e.g., seasonality, demand forecasting, pricing performance, customer engagement)
Partner with global and regional stakeholders to define and maintain standardized KPIs (e.g., occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, GOP, channel mix)
Own the end-to-end development of dashboards and reporting frameworks in PBI for hotel performance across regions
Ensure metrics for business performance are defined, measured, and maintained consistently across teams to support scalability and transparency
Partner with Commercial and Operations teams to identify performance drivers and opportunities across markets, lines of business, and properties Translate recurring requirements of commercial and operational teams into automated, self-service dashboards
Deliver actionable insights on revenue trends, booking behaviour and operational efficiency


Requirements:


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Economics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field
6 -8 years of experience in customer analytics, data science, or business intelligence, preferably within luxury hospitality, travel, or consumer sectors
Demonstrated expertise in predictive modelling and business analysis
Proficiency in SQL and Power BI required; experience with Python, R, or statistical modeling tools preferred
Experience with DBT, GitHub and Snowflake
Experience integrating data from CRM, PMS, and external sources
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to communicate insights to senior stakeholders
Deep understanding of data governance, privacy compliance, and analytical best practices


Benefits

At Aman Group, we believe our colleagues are at the core of our success. We offer competitive benefits, including exciting global career opportunities within a rapidly expanding company. We prioritize and support your professional journey, ensuring you feel valued, included, and at home.

If you are passionate about attracting exceptional talent and creating a positive experience for every candidate, we invite you to apply to join us on our journey.

Title: Spécialiste controlling et reportings crédits
Description:
Et si votre histoire professionnelle se poursuivait à la BCV ?

Mettez vos ambitions managériales au service d’une performance saine et durable en rejoignant la première banque universelle du canton de Vaud, l’une des banques les plus solides au monde, et ses quelque 2000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs. Prenez part au succès d’une institution notée AA par Standard & Poor’s depuis 2011 et contribuez à l’essor du tissu économique vaudois ainsi qu’à l’attractivité et à la vitalité de notre région.

Pour notre département Stratégie et Organisation, nous recherchons un ou une :

Spécialiste controlling et reportings crédits 60 à 100%

Vos missions


Produire les reportings à destination des entités internes (Département, Direction générale, Conseil d'administration) et externes (Finma, BNS), en utilisant des outils comme RStudio/R
Assurer le bon fonctionnement des End User Computings (EUCs) (en Access/VBA) du département et apporter un support interne à la Division pour ces développements.
Optimiser les sources d'information internes et externes afin de fournir au Département, à la Division et à la Banque des données fiables et pertinentes.
Assurer le controlling du Département Support crédits : analyses liées au suivi des risques crédits (monitoring, dépassements/découverts, etc.) et établissement des statistiques.
Détecter les opportunités de simplification et proposer des améliorations de procédures sur la base d'une analyse quantitative, objective et financière.
Participer à des groupes de travail (IT et/ou processus), voire les conduire, et contribuer à l'analyse de la situation actuelle et future.
Rendre compte de l'avancement des projets à la hiérarchie, en mettant en évidence les risques (budget, délais).


Votre profil


Formation supérieure en ingénierie, en informatique, finance ou sciences (EPF, HES ou équivalent).
Au minimum 1 an d'expérience professionnelle ; une expérience dans le reporting bancaire est un atout.
Aisance avec la programmation (RStudio/R, Python); connaissances d'Access/VBA, SQL souhaitées.
Aisance avec le requêtage et la manipulation de données.
Esprit d'analyse, sens du détail et orientation solution.
Volonté d'optimiser les processus existants.
Personnalité agréable, à l'aise dans un travail d'équipe.
Parfaite maîtrise du français et bon niveau d'anglais


Si ce poste est fait pour vous, postulez dès maintenant et participez à l’avenir prometteur de la BCV. Ecrivons ensemble trois histoires, celle de votre carrière, celle de votre banque, celle de notre région.

Title: Business Analyst – Payments and Fintech
Description:
The Company

At lastminute.com, we live for the holidays. We are the European Travel-Tech leader in Dynamic Holiday Packages. With technology, we turn spontaneous thoughts into meaningful experiences, helping people travel the world.

Job Description

We are looking for a Business Analyst to join our Payments & Fintech team. You will be the person who knows how our checkout and payments are really performing, why, and what to do about it.

You will combine strong data skills with a solid understanding of how an e-commerce business makes money: revenue, costs, margins and the trade-offs between conversion and risk. You will turn data into decisions, spot problems before they become expensive, and help shape what the product team builds next.

This is a junior-to-mid level role, ideal for someone with 4–5 years of experience who wants real ownership and experience across Product and Data teams, and grows into Business roles.

What You’ll Do

Performance monitoring and insights


Own the monitoring of payments and checkout performance: conversion, payment method adoption, drop-off rates, market share and other key KPIs, across markets, brands and devices.
Translate KPI movements into their business impact on revenue, costs and margin, and recommend actions.
Prepare regular business reviews (data, insights and slides) and present them to stakeholders and management.


Anomaly detection and alerting


Be the first line of detection for anomalies in payments and checkout, and coordinate investigations and resolutions with Product, Engineering and external partners.
Own our real-time alerting system for payments and checkout (currently Grafana/Prometheus): configure and maintain alerts, tune thresholds to reduce noise, and extend coverage as the business grows.


Business partnering


Join meetings with payment partners and internal teams, bringing data to the discussion and keeping the focus on what matters for the business.
Support the product team and business team in discovery: size opportunities, define success metrics and help with assessing the results of launches and complex A/B tests.
Scout the market and competitors for benchmarks, new payment methods and fintech trends.


AI and automation


Use AI tools to connect the dots across user data, payment data and other internal sources, uncovering insights that would be hard to find manually.
Build lightweight apps, automations and prototypes (“vibe coding”) that make analysis faster and help the whole team work smarter.


Who You’ll Work With

You will sit in the Payments & Fintech team and work daily with:


Product team: to shape discovery, define metrics and measure what we ship.
Business team: to steer commercial decisions with data and support partner relationships.
Data Analytics team: to align on data sources, definitions and shared reporting.


You will also be in regular contact with payment service providers and other external partners.

Title: Digital Analytics Consultant - Geneva (H/F)
Description:
fifty-five is a new kind of data company that helps brands transform with data and AI to improve their marketing operations through a combination of specialized consultancy and technology services.

As the strategic data pillar of The Brandtech Group, we offer services that combine strategy consulting, cloud services, media consulting and customer experience.

We are made up of over +320 digital experts. Digital consultants, tracking and media specialists, engineers and data scientists all work in close collaboration to provide senior-level marketing consultancy and technical support to our clients, in every type of industry, all around the world.

As a partner to advertisers from data collection to activation and exploitation, we help organizations become truly omnichannel entities that control the efficiency of their digital ecosystem and its synergies with the physical world.

Headquartered in Paris, we operate across 3 time zones from our 10 offices, located in Paris, London, Geneva, Milan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Shenzhen, Taipei, Singapore and New York. fifty-five attaches particular importance to the well-being of its employees, which enabled it to be included in the Best Workplaces France ranking in 2018.

Within the consulting team based in Geneva, you will actively take part in delivering fifty-five's data-led projects to multiple clients. Those projects will be driven by client objectives relating to data collection, customer acquisition, onsite conversion optimisation, media-mix optimisation and digital business consulting. During these projects, you will contribute to promoting a customer-centred vision of digital marketing, based on the systematic and methodical use of data to support decisions. You will work across multiple industries including luxury, FMCG, sport, and beauty.

You will report to a Local Executive Director and will work closely with Product, Engineering and Operations Teams based in Paris. As a data analyst and consultant, you will follow an action plan, issuing step-by-step the deliverables required for successful delivery of the project. You will guarantee the integrity of analytics data as well as its analysis and interpretation in working with your team and client.

You will be responsible for the content, the format and overall quality of the outputs delivered to the client and for monitoring their operational and technical implementation where required. Based on your good understanding of our projects and our clients' needs, you will collaborate with all our teams to develop fifty-five's offer, both in terms of marketing and in terms of technical and operational delivery.


Responsibilities

Deliver projects related to the monitoring of the client's digital activity based on key performance indicators (reporting), to onsite conversion optimization through data analysis and webtesting, to online media buy optimization and CRM.
Analyse data and structure relevant information for the client's benefit, in consistency with business indicators specific to their industry (eg. mobile operators, retail, travel, etc.)
Develop a sharp operational expertise on both conversion and online media-buy topics
Meet clients' needs and pay strong attention to the quality of all deliverables
Occasional travel possible, within Switzerland or abroad (including Paris)

Education and Experience

Master's degree (business, engineering) or equivalent diploma
Experience in digital marketing, consulting firms, marketing or business intelligence software, or media agencies
Working with web analytics tools
Knowledge of the main online acquisition channels: SEO, SEM and bidmanagement, display and programmatic, affiliates, email and social media


Skills and Interests

Fluent in French & English and excellent communication, oral and written
Strong analytical skills and knowledge of analysis, statistical software and data vizualization tool
Good business and market understanding
Client-facing skills
Good team spirit
Strong interest in new technologies and the digital industry

Title: Senior Digital Analytics Consultant H/F (Geneva)
Description:
fifty-five is a new kind of data company that helps brands transform with data and AI to improve their marketing operations through a combination of specialized consultancy and technology services.

As the strategic data pillar of The Brandtech Group, we offer services that combine strategy consulting, cloud services, media consulting and customer experience.

We are made up of over +320 digital experts. Digital consultants, tracking and media specialists, engineers and data scientists all work in close collaboration to provide senior-level marketing consultancy and technical support to our clients, in every type of industry, all around the world.

As a partner to advertisers from data collection to activation and exploitation, we help organizations become truly omnichannel entities that control the efficiency of their digital ecosystem and its synergies with the physical world.

Headquartered in Paris, we operate across 3 time zones from our 10 offices, located in Paris, London, Geneva, Milan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Shenzhen, Taipei, Singapore and New York. fifty-five attaches particular importance to the well-being of its employees, which enabled it to be included in the Best Workplaces France ranking in 2018.

Within the consulting team based in Geneva, you will actively take part in delivering fifty-five's data-led projects to multiple clients. Those projects will be driven by client objectives relating to data collection, customer acquisition, onsite conversion optimisation, media-mix optimisation and digital business consulting. During these projects, you will contribute to promoting a customer-centred vision of digital marketing, based on the systematic and methodical use of data to support decisions. You will work across multiple industries including luxury, FMCG, sport, and beauty.


You will report to a Local Executive Director and will work closely with Product, Engineering and Operations Teams based in Paris. As a data analyst and consultant, you will follow an action plan, issuing step-by-step the deliverables required for successful delivery of the project. You will guarantee the integrity of analytics data as well as its analysis and interpretation in working with your team and client.


You will be responsible for the content, the format and overall quality of the outputs delivered to the client and for monitoring their operational and technical implementation where required. Based on your good understanding of our projects and our clients' needs, you will collaborate with all our teams to develop fifty-five's offer, both in terms of marketing and in terms of technical and operational delivery.



Responsibilities


Deliver projects related to the monitoring of the client's digital activity based on key performance indicators (reporting), to onsite conversion optimization through data analysis and webtesting, to online media buy optimization and CRM.
Analyse data and structure relevant information for the client's benefit, in consistency with business indicators specific to their industry (eg. mobile operators, retail, travel, etc.)
Develop a sharp operational expertise on both conversion and online media-buy topics
Meet clients' needs and pay strong attention to the quality of all deliverables
Occasional travel possible, within Switzerland or abroad (including Paris)


Education and Experience


Master's degree (business, engineering) or equivalent diploma
1 to 3 years experience in digital marketing, consulting firms, marketing or business intelligence software, or media agencies
Working with web analytics tools
Knowledge of the main online acquisition channels: SEO, SEM and bidmanagement, display and programmatic, affiliates, email and social media

Skills and Interests


Fluent in French & English and excellent communication, oral and written
Strong analytical skills and knowledge of analysis, statistical software and data vizualization tool
Good business and market understanding
Client-facing skills
Good team spirit
Strong interest in new technologies and the digital industry

Kommunikationsdaten gemäss sicherheitspolitischen Zielsetzungen auf ihre Relevanz prüfen und inhaltlich analysieren
Analyseergebnisse mit Informationen aus öffentlich zugänglichen Quellen anreichern

Optimierung bestehender sowie Erarbeitung neuer Prozesse, Methoden und Analysetechniken aktiv mitgestalten

Hohes Verständnis für technische Zusammenhänge und Kompetenzen im Bereich Cyber, Telekommunikation, Informatik und/oder Data Science
Gute aktive Kenntnisse einer zweiten Amtssprache und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse; Sprachkenntnisse in Mandarin (B2–C1) sind von Vorteil

Du arbeitest selbstständig in einem Analyseteam an vorgegebenen Themenbereichen. Das Kommando Cyber (Kdo Cy) steht für Kompetenz in den Bereichen Cyber und Digitalisierung. Title: Marketing Analyst, New Business and M&A
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Marketing Analyst, New Business and M&A based in Switzerland.

As a Marketing Analyst, you will build and manage the marketing analytics infrastructure that supports new business ventures and companies integrated through mergers and acquisitions (M&A). You will transform paid advertising data into actionable insights that guide acquisition strategies, budget allocation, and business growth. Working across marketing analytics, data engineering, and business intelligence, you will establish reliable tracking systems, develop performance models, and create dashboards that connect advertising spend to revenue outcomes. You will collaborate closely with business analysts, marketing leaders, and operational stakeholders to evaluate performance and identify opportunities for improvement. This role combines hands-on technical expertise with strategic thinking, giving you the opportunity to influence decisions across diverse businesses in a global, fully remote environment. You will also leverage AI-powered tools and scalable analytical processes to strengthen reporting capabilities and accelerate data-driven decision-making.

Accountabilities


Build and maintain marketing data infrastructure: Develop and manage end-to-end data systems that connect advertising impressions, clicks, lead acquisition, engagement, and revenue, integrating Google Analytics, Google Ads, and other relevant marketing platforms.
Integrate newly acquired businesses: Rapidly assess and incorporate the marketing data infrastructure of acquired companies, establishing reliable tracking, attribution, reporting, and measurement standards.
Analyze advertising performance: Evaluate paid acquisition channels and campaigns using metrics such as customer acquisition cost (CAC), return on advertising spend (ROAS), customer lifetime value (LTV), funnel conversion, and payback periods to optimize marketing investments.
Develop analytical models and forecasts: Use SQL, statistical analysis, predictive modeling, and hypothesis testing to identify performance drivers, forecast outcomes, diagnose issues, and evaluate potential improvements.
Create dashboards and performance reports: Build and maintain clear, actionable reporting solutions using business intelligence tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Qlik to support marketing teams and business leaders.
Define and standardize performance metrics: Establish consistent, accurate, and strategically aligned definitions for LTV, ROAS, CAC, and other key indicators across businesses to improve comparability and decision-making.
Translate data into business recommendations: Conduct descriptive and diagnostic analyses, identify root causes, and communicate the business implications of findings through practical recommendations that improve marketing efficiency and financial performance.
Collaborate across business functions: Work closely with business analysts focused on new ventures and acquisitions, connecting marketing performance with revenue, unit economics, operational effectiveness, and broader business objectives.
Map marketing processes and data flows: Understand how marketing activities translate into data across acquisition, engagement, conversion, and revenue generation, identifying gaps and opportunities for improvement.
Identify opportunities for optimization: Proactively recommend improvements in campaign efficiency, conversion rates, revenue generation, customer and talent experience, operational processes, communication, systems, and resource allocation.
Leverage AI and automation: Use generative AI tools to accelerate analytical work, automate reporting workflows, and improve the scalability and efficiency of marketing analytics.
Support strategic business decisions: Provide insights that inform marketing budgets, channel strategies, business priorities, performance targets, and long-term growth initiatives.
Build a repeatable M&A analytics framework: Develop standardized processes and playbooks for integrating marketing data from acquired companies and continuously improving measurement capabilities.


Requirements


Education: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field is required. A background in mathematics, statistics, science, finance, or engineering is highly valuable. An advanced degree or MBA is an advantage.
Professional experience: At least three years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or analytics, with a strong focus on marketing performance.
Paid media analytics: Demonstrated experience evaluating paid advertising campaigns, including Google Ads and other paid media platforms, and translating campaign performance into metrics such as CAC, LTV, ROAS, and payback.
Marketing data infrastructure: Hands-on experience building or managing tracking systems, attribution models, data pipelines, and marketing reporting infrastructure.
Google ecosystem expertise: Strong technical knowledge of Google Analytics, Google Ads, and related data integrations, with the ability to work across different marketing platforms and business environments.
Business intelligence tools: Experience developing dashboards and reports using Tableau, Power BI, Qlik, or comparable analytics platforms.
Technical proficiency: Strong SQL skills are required. Experience with Python, R, or MATLAB is an advantage.
Analytical and statistical skills: Working knowledge of probability, statistics, exploratory data analysis, hypothesis testing, root cause analysis, forecasting, predictive modeling, and performance measurement.
Generative AI experience: Practical experience using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini to support analysis, automate workflows, and improve reporting efficiency.
Business-oriented problem-solving: Proven ability to connect analytical findings with marketing strategy, financial performance, and operational outcomes, turning complex data into measurable business impact.
Process improvement: Experience mapping business processes, identifying inefficiencies, and developing scalable analytical frameworks is beneficial.
Startup and M&A exposure: Experience working with startups, early-stage businesses, newly launched ventures, or post-acquisition integrations is a plus.
Stakeholder management: Ability to build productive relationships across teams, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Communication skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex analytical concepts clearly, challenge assumptions constructively, and communicate data limitations and potential blind spots.
Ownership and execution: A proactive, hands-on approach, strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines independently.
Remote collaboration: Ability to work effectively with globally distributed teams and communicate professionally in English. Applications and related communication must be submitted in English.
Work authorization: This is a remote position; visa sponsorship or immigration assistance is not provided.


Benefits


Fully remote work: Work remotely within the eligible geographic locations, collaborating with an international team across Europe, South America, and Central America.
Global exposure: Contribute to analytics initiatives spanning new business ventures and acquired companies, gaining insight into diverse business models, marketing strategies, and operational environments.
Strategic impact: Influence acquisition spending, channel strategy, financial performance, and business growth through data-driven recommendations.
Professional development: Build expertise across marketing analytics, business intelligence, data infrastructure, forecasting, and M&A integration.
Technical ownership: Take responsibility for designing and improving analytical systems, reporting frameworks, and scalable measurement processes.
AI-driven innovation: Work with modern generative AI tools and automation techniques to improve analytical productivity and reporting capabilities.
Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with business analysts, marketing leaders, and operational teams to solve complex challenges and deliver measurable results.
Career growth opportunities: Develop your capabilities in a fast-moving, global organization where independent contribution, initiative, and continuous improvement are highly valued.

As a Marketing Analyst, you will build and manage the marketing analytics infrastructure that supports new business ventures and companies integrated through mergers and acquisitions (M&A). You will transform paid advertising data into actionable insights that guide acquisition strategies, budget allocation, and business growth. Working across marketing analytics, data engineering, and business intelligence, you will establish reliable tracking systems, develop performance models, and create dashboards that connect advertising spend to revenue outcomes. You will collaborate closely with business analysts, marketing leaders, and operational stakeholders to evaluate performance and identify opportunities for improvement. This role combines hands-on technical expertise with strategic thinking, giving you the opportunity to influence decisions across diverse businesses in a global, fully remote environment. You will also leverage AI-powered tools and scalable analytical processes to strengthen reporting capabilities and accelerate data-driven decision-making.

Accountabilities

  • Build and maintain marketing data infrastructure: Develop and manage end-to-end data systems that connect advertising impressions, clicks, lead acquisition, engagement, and revenue, integrating Google Analytics, Google Ads, and other relevant marketing platforms.
  • Integrate newly acquired businesses: Rapidly assess and incorporate the marketing data infrastructure of acquired companies, establishing reliable tracking, attribution, reporting, and measurement standards.
  • Analyze advertising performance: Evaluate paid acquisition channels and campaigns using metrics such as customer acquisition cost (CAC), return on advertising spend (ROAS), customer lifetime value (LTV), funnel conversion, and payback periods to optimize marketing investments.

Title: LPG Analyst
Description:
As an LPG Analyst to support our global oil trading team, providing in-depth market analysis, building and updating supply and demand models, providing value-add market insights, and analyzing high-frequency indicators of market dynamics. The role is based in Geneva, Switzerland.

Key Responsibilities

Collating, analysing and interpreting data to produce commodity market insights

Conduct comprehensive research and analysis on fuel oil markets, including supply/demand dynamics, pricing trends, arbitrage opportunities, and regulatory developments across major global trading hubs

Build and maintaining supply and demand models, and develop detailed market reports, presentations, and trade recommendations to inform trading strategies

Provide trade flow analysis and other ad-hoc analysis to support decision-making by senior traders and management

Collaborate closely with traders, operations teams, and other analysts to identify trading opportunities, monitor positions, and manage risk exposure

Build and maintain proprietary models and tools for market analysis, forecasting, and scenario planning.

Stay up-to-date on industry news, market intelligence, and competitor activities to provide a competitive edge

Establish strong relationships with key market participants, including refiners, suppliers, and customers, to gather market intelligence.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a related quantitative field;

Minimum of 4 years of experience in commodity analysis or a related analytical role, preferably with exposure to fuel oil/refined products markets

Prior experience in commodity research, specifically in LPG analytics

Strong quantitative and analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex data sets and extract meaningful insights

Experience using trade data, data visualization tools and statistical data modeling software.

Proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Python, R, SQL) and Microsoft Office suite.

Knowledge of commodity trading fundamentals, risk management principles, and financial modeling

Fluency in English

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced educational degree

Fluency in another foreign language

Programming experience and a solid understanding of database concepts (Python and SQL preferred; R, MATLAB or VBA beneficial).

Direct knowledge of LPG markets

Attributes for success

Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely

Strong intrinsic interest in financial markets, geopolitical developments and a sound understanding of economic theory and cycles

Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Ability to work independently and proactively to deliver timely results.

Analytical mindset and critical thinking skills, with an emphasis on providing proactive insights that have tradeable value.

Work Authorization:

We welcome applications from candidates across the globe. Relocation support and visa sponsorship details will be discussed during the hiring process.

Reporting Structure

- Reporting directly to Head of Oil Research Europe & Asia

Title: Lead Portfolio and Performance Analytics
Description:
Are you looking for your next opportunity?

Sompo has a unique opportunity for a Lead, Portfolio and Performance Analytics in our newly established CUO Office team for Continental Europe.

Reporting directly to the Chief Underwriting Officer (CUO) for Continental Europe, this role offers a unique opportunity to lay the groundwork for a central function that supports portfolio monitoring and sustainable profitability across Sompo’s commercial insurance operations in Continental Europe. As a foundational member of the CUO Office, you will play a pivotal role in shaping its capabilities, focusing on building robust analytical frameworks and performance monitoring tools from the ground up.

This hands-on position requires a proactive and detail-oriented individual who thrives on creating structure and driving meaningful change. While business decisions will remain the responsibility of underwriters, you will serve as a critical voice in influencing underwriting strategies and supporting data-driven decision-making processes. Your contributions will be instrumental in optimizing portfolio performance, enhancing risk management practices, and aligning operations with strategic objectives.

As the CUO Office evolves, this role offers the potential to expand its scope and contributes to the development of a team that will further enhance the organization’s portfolio analytics capabilities. This is an exciting chance to make a lasting impact on the organization’s success and shape the future of portfolio analytics within a dynamic and globally connected environment.

Location: This position will be based preferably out of our Zurich office, but potential candidates might also sit in our other European office locations in Paris, Milan, Cologne or Munich. We strive for collaboration which is why we offer a work environment where our employees thrive and develop long lasting careers.

Our business, your impact, our opportunity

What You’ll Be Doing


Portfolio Performance Analysis: Regularly evaluate underwriting performance, identify trends, and analyze profitability, risk quality, and portfolio composition to drive growth and improvement. Prepare quarterly and ad-hoc performance reviews for leadership.
Underwriting Portfolio Steering: Refine risk appetite, recommend strategies for growth or remediation, support underwriting plans, and monitor execution against targets.
Risk Aggregation & Management: Analyze risk accumulation across perils and geographies, monitor exposure limits, and integrate data into reinsurance and capital modeling.
Catastrophe & Scenario Analysis: Conduct catastrophe loss scenarios, assess tail risks, and support stress testing, capital planning, and reinsurance structuring.
Pricing & Profitability Support: Collaborate with pricing teams to analyze rate adequacy, validate assumptions, and recommend underwriting and renewal actions.
Predictive Analytics: Develop predictive models and leverage advanced analytics to support underwriting automation and decision-making tools.
Reporting & Dashboards: Create executive dashboards, automate underwriting metric reporting, and provide data-driven insights for decision-makers.
Reinsurance Strategy Support: Provide exposure and performance data to inform treaty and facultative decisions and improve retention strategies.
Regulatory & Capital Requirements: Support regulatory filings, collaborate on risk assessments, and align portfolio decisions with capital efficiency.
Innovation & Technology: Pilot AI models, integrate new data sources, and drive digitization of portfolio management processes.


What You’ll Bring

This role requires a strategic thinker with a deep understanding of commercial insurance, strong analytical capabilities, industry expertise, and a passion for driving innovation to optimize portfolio performance and deliver value to internal and external stakeholders.


Advanced degree in Finance, Actuarial Science, Data Analytics, Risk Management, Business Administration, or a related field
Minimum 5 to 10 years of experience in commercial insurance, with a focus on large corporate industry portfolios.
Strong knowledge of underwriting principles, risk aggregation, catastrophe modeling, and reinsurance structures.
General understanding of insurance product coverages, resulting exposures and their triggering portfolio impacts.
Proficiency in data analytics tools and predictive modeling (Python or R)
Expertise in regulatory compliance (e.g., Solvency II, NAIC), capital modeling, and risk management.
Proven leadership and collaboration skills with cross-functional teams and executive management.
Innovative and investigative mindset with experience in leveraging technology, advanced analytics, and digitization for portfolio optimization
Natural curiosity with a drive to uncover insights and understand underlying patterns


Our Benefits

We continuously evaluate and update our benefit programs to ensure that our plans meet the needs of our employees and their dependents. Below are a few highlights of our inclusive benefit programs:


Expansive Health & Wellness Benefits
Generous Retirement & Savings Plans
Global Parental Leave & Adoption Assistance


In today’s world, what do we stand for?

We strive to create exceptional value for our clients and shareholders while maintaining Sompo as an attractive place to work. We foster an environment of ongoing, open dialogue between managers and their direct reports, and believe in an organizational environment where everyone belongs. We proudly are a multi-racial, multi-cultural, global enterprise. We reject all forms of racism, bigotry, prejudice and injustice and continue to invest in building out an inclusive and diverse work environment.

About Us

Expert Partners.

Clarity in complexity.

Unwavering commitment.

We are Sompo, a global provider of property, casualty, and specialty insurance and reinsurance.

Building on Sompo Holding’s 135 years of innovation, we seek to deliver a unified approach to servicing and providing customized solutions for our clients, ensuring that we meet their needs effectively and consistently.

We strive to strengthen engagement with our clients and business partners every day by using the in-depth knowledge and insights of our experts to swiftly navigate the ever-shifting risk landscape in a fast and agile way – providing them with the products and coverages they need – underpinned by exceptional levels of service.

Our values

As we continue to evolve and grow, our core values serve as the foundation for our company’s identity, purpose and culture.


Accountability: Raising the bar on what we deliver
Agility: Keeping it simple as we grow
Collaboration: Building relationships with clients and colleagues
Development: Being curious and having a growth mindset
Integrity: Being trustworthy and doing what’s right


Around the world, our 9,500+ employees use their expertise to learn, improve and find clear answers for your complex challenges. Because when you choose Sompo, you choose the ease of expertise.

Sompo is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

To learn more about visit our website at www.sompo-intl.com

Gemeinsam bauen wir Netze, produzieren Energie, planen und realisieren energieeffiziente Gebäude und gestalten nachhaltige Lebensräume von morgen.
Dazu brauchen wir Sie: Menschen mit Ideen und Engagement. Leisten Sie mit uns einen wertvollen Beitrag für die Gesellschaft und unsere Umwelt!

80-100%

Du gestaltest die digitale Transformation bei BKW Power Grid mit. In 18 Monaten lernst du drei unterschiedliche Bereiche des Netzgeschäfts kennen und entwickelst deine Kenntnisse rund um Daten, Prozesse und Systeme weiter. Start: 1. März 2027.
